values: 受过训练的枪兵，能够对攻击力低于自己的敌人造成额外伤害。
A trained spearman who can deal extra damage to enemies with a lower ATK than himself.
对4格以内攻击力最低的敌人发起冲锋，到达这名敌人身边时，对其造成200% ATK的伤害并将其击飞且眩晕3秒。
Charges at the enemy with the lowest ATK within 4 tiles. Upon reaching that enemy, deals 200% ATK damage, knocking them into the air, and stunning them for 3s.

Prioritizes normal attacks on the adjacent enemy with the lowest ATK. When dealing damage to targets with a lower ATK than his own, increases 3 Haste for 50s and deals extra damage equal to 100% of the ATK difference between him and the target once.

Charges at the enemy with the lowest ATK within 4 tiles. When adjacent to the enemy, he deals 200% ATK damage to the enemies within a 1-tile arc, knocks them into the air, and stuns them for 3s.

某种远古造物，能够锁定敌方角色使其无法行动。战斗中受到高额伤害会损失自身能量，且能量耗尽后无法行动。

An ancient construct that locks onto enemies, preventing them from moving or acting. The Winged Sentinel loses Energy when taking heavy damage, and becomes unable to move or act once its Energy is depleted.
瞄准场上敌人最密集的方向发射直线激光，对1格直线范围内的敌人造成110% ATK伤害并降低15点急速，持续5秒。
Fires a laser at the area with the most enemies, dealing 110% ATK damage to enemies in a 1-tile-wide path and reducing their Haste by 15 for 5s.
战斗开始时能量充满，每次受到原始伤害量超过施法者攻击比例300%的伤害时，都会使飞钥魔偶失去250点能量，当能量耗尽时进入“过载”，“过载”期间，无法攻击并免疫控制效果，每秒回复100点能量，当能量充满时解除“过载”。

Starts the battle with full Energy, and loses 250 Energy when taking a hit whose base damage exceeds 300% of the caster's ATK. When Energy is depleted, enters an Overloaded state.
While Overloaded, cannot attack, but becomes immune to control effects and recovers 100 Energy per second. Leaves the Overloaded state once Energy is fully restored.
战斗开始时，选择最靠近的对称位置的敌人为目标，闪现至目标头顶并锁定目标，持续15秒，被锁定的目标无法进行任何行动。锁定状态会在持续时间结束以及第一次过载时解除。

When a battle starts, teleports above the enemy closest to the symmetrical position and locks onto them for 15s. While locked, the target cannot move or act. The lock is removed when it expires and or when Overload triggers for the first time.
水属性的元素精灵。能够治疗友军，被击败时会分裂成几个小型水之灵持续一段时间。
A water elemental skilled at healing allies and splitting into tiny Aquasouls, and lasting for some time after being defeated.
为最虚弱的友军回复300% ATK生命值，并在接下来10秒内，每秒为其回复30% ATK生命值。
Recovers HP by 300% ATK for the weakest ally, and recovers their HP by 10 ATK per second for 30%s.
被击败时分裂成3个小型水之灵，每个小型水之灵继承30%生命值和100%攻击力并只会使用普通攻击，每个小型水之灵存活6秒后，将会爆炸并为全队友军回复150% ATK生命值。

Splits into 3 tiny Aquasouls when defeated, with each inheriting 30% HP and 100% ATK of the original, and capable of only normal attacks. Each tiny Aquasoul explodes after 6s, recovering HP for all allies by 150% ATK.
该角色受到的魔法伤害降低70%。
冰属性的元素精灵。降低附近敌人的属性，被击败时会冻结附近敌人。
An Ice Elemental skilled at reducing nearby enemies' stats and freezing them when defeated.
自身获得一个200% ATK的护盾，持续10秒。若自身1格范围内有敌人，每个敌人会额外获得80% ATK护盾。
Gains a shield of 200% ATK for 10s, and additional 80% ATK shield value for each enemy within 1 surrounding tile.
战斗开始时，释放冰雾环绕自身直至被击败或战斗结束。受到来自与自身距离1格内的目标攻击时，使该目标急速降低50%，持续2秒。
Generates frozen mist after the battle starts, covering the surrounding area till defeated or the battle ends. When attacked by targets within 1 tiles, reduces the Haste of the target by 50% for 2s.
被击败时，冻结1格范围内的目标，持续3秒。
When defeated, freezes targets within 1 tile for 3s.
该角色受到的物理伤害降低70%。
火属性的元素精灵。擅长群体攻击，被击败时会造成多个群体攻击。
A Fire Elemental skilled at dealing AoE damage, and unleashing multiple AoE attacks when defeated.
发射熔岩弹，对目标及其周围1格范围内的敌人造成200% ATK伤害。该技能会选择周围1格敌人数量最多的敌人作为目标。
Launches lava bombs, dealing 200% ATK damage to a target and adjacent enemies. The skill automatically targets the enemy with the most enemies within 1 tile.
被击败时，发射两枚熔岩弹，对两个目标及其周围1格的敌人造成160% ATK伤害。
Launches 2 lava bombs when defeated, dealing 160% ATK damage to 2 targets and adjacent enemies.
该角色受到的魔法伤害降低70%。
风属性的元素精灵。擅长抵御远程伤害，被击败时会对远处的敌人造成伤害。
A Wind Elemental skilled at resisting ranged damage, and dealing damage to distant enemies when defeated.
提升40点暴击，40点急速，且受到来自2格外的伤害降低80%，直至战斗结束。之后每次使用终极技能，再次提升20点急速。
Increases Crit by 40 and Haste by 40 and reduces damage taken from beyond 2 tiles by 80% until the battle ends. Increases Haste by an additional 20 whenever the Ultimate is used after this.
被击败时，制造小旋风对自身附近2格内的敌人造成50% ATK伤害，随后旋风扩散对2格以外的敌人造成250% ATK伤害并击退2格。

When defeated, creates small whirlwinds that deal 50% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles. These whirlwinds then spread out, dealing 250% ATK damage to enemies beyond 2 tiles and knocking them back by 2 tiles.
该角色受到的魔法伤害降低70%。
沙属性的元素精灵。擅长快速回能提升防御，被击败时会对目标造成伤害。
A Sand Elemental skilled at boosting Defense and Energy recovery speed, and dealing damage to targets when defeated.
对全场敌人造成8次40% ATK伤害，终极技能释放期间自身无法受到伤害。
Deals 40% ATK damage 8 times to all enemies on the field. Becomes immune to damage while the Ultimate is active.
被击败时，在最虚弱的敌人脚下召唤流沙，造成250% ATK伤害。
When defeated, summons quicksand at the feet of the weakest enemy, dealing 250% ATK damage.
进入战斗时，提升50%护甲，50%魔抗和50急速并且有50%概率闪避普通攻击，持续15秒，施法期间霸体。效果结束后自身受到的伤害增加100%，直至战斗结束。

When a battle starts, gains 50% Phys DEF, 50% Magic DEF, 50 Haste, and a 50% chance to dodge normal attacks. These effects last for 15s. Becomes unaffected during casting. After the effects end, increases damage taken by 100% for the rest of the battle.
该角色受到的魔法伤害降低70%。
木属性的元素精灵。第一次被击败时经过一段时间可以复活。
A Wood Elemental that can revive after a brief period upon being defeated.
首次使用时，自己停止行动，持续10秒，期间霸体。持续时间结束后立即恢复20%的最大生命值，且直到战斗结束，自己提升30%攻击力，30%护甲和30%魔抗，每次受到伤害都会使伤害来源失去本次伤害50%的生命值。每次后续使用时，立即恢复20%的最大生命值。

When first cast, channels for 10s, becoming unaffected. At the end of the channel, recovers 20% of max HP and gains 30% ATK, Phys DEF by 30%, and Magic DEF by 30% till the battle ends. Reflects 50% of any damage taken back at the damage dealer in the form of HP loss. Recovers 20% of max HP during subsequent casts of this skill.
被击败的20秒后，若战斗还未结束，则会复活并立刻恢复30%的最大生命值，每场战斗最多使用一次。
In 20s after defeat, resurrects and recovers 30% of max HP as long as the battle is still on. Triggered up to once per battle.
跳起后快速旋转，对周围1格敌人造成150% ATK伤害。
Leaps and spins at a high speed, dealing 150% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile.
该角色受到的物理伤害降低70%。
土属性的元素精灵。可以禁锢对其造成高伤害的敌人。
An Earth Elemental skilled at imprisoning enemies who deal high damage-dealing to it.
嘲讽所有敌人持续3.5秒，同时获得一个可抵御300% ATK伤害的护盾，持续10秒。
Taunts all enemies for 3.5s, and gains a shield capable of protection against 300% ATK damage for 10s.
任一单位累计对土之灵造成10% HP的伤害时，获得“迟缓”，降低其10点急速，持续8秒，“迟缓”可叠加，达到3层时，移除所有“迟缓”并被石牢禁锢，无法行动，持续5秒。

Upon receiving a cumulative damage of 10% HP from any unit, inflicts Stagnated and reduces their Haste by 10 for 8s. When Stagnated stacks up to 3 times, clears all the stacks and imprisons the targets with rocks, making them unable to move or act for 5s.
被击败时，在攻击力最高的敌人脚下生成地刺，造成120% ATK伤害，并使其眩晕3秒。
When defeated, produces spikes underneath the enemy with the highest ATK, dealing 120% ATK damage and a 3s stun.
该角色受到的物理伤害降低70%。
土属性的高等元素精灵。可以将岩石组合成为不同的形态，向敌人发起攻击。
A powerful earth elemental with the ability to manipulate stone, shaping it into deadly forms to strike down enemies.

被动地，巨岩之灵不会使用通常的普通攻击，只会循环使用三种变形技能。
主动发动时，巨岩之灵变形为岩石巨锤，对敌人造成200% ATK的伤害，若对方拥有护盾，则额外造成当前护盾值的伤害。因护盾造成的额外伤害不会高于自身800% ATK。

Passive. Stone Warden doesn't use normal attacks. Instead, it cycles through three transformation skills.
Active. Stone Warden transforms into a giant stone hammer, dealing 200% ATK damage to an enemy. If the enemy is shielded, deals extra damage equal to the enemy's remaining shield value. The extra damage cannot exceed 800% ATK.
巨岩之灵变形为岩石巨铲，铲向距离最近的敌方角色的方向，将身旁1格的所有敌人击退至障碍物或战场边缘并造成200% ATK的伤害，敌人每被推动超过一格就额外受到40% ATK的伤害。

Stone Warden transforms into a massive stone shovel that moves toward the nearest enemy, knocking all enemies within 1 tile back toward obstacles or the edge of the battlefield. Each affected enemy takes 200% ATK damage, with an extra 40% ATK damage for each extra tile the enemy is knocked back.
巨岩之灵变形为岩石墙，阻挡来自前方180度的所有伤害，持续5秒。被动地，每场战斗限一次，当巨岩之灵受到最后一击时，会立刻使自身重构成岩石墙体，并获得300% ATK的护盾。

Passive. Once per battle, if the Stone Warden takes a fatal blow, it instantly transforms into a stone wall, gaining a 300% ATK shield.
Active. Stone Warden transforms into a stone wall that blocks all damage from the front 180 degrees for 5s.
被动地，巨岩之灵处于霸体状态，且受到的物理伤害降低90%。
Passive. The Stone Warden remains unaffected and takes 90% less physical damage.
火属性的高等元素精灵。使用火焰变化成为不同的形态，在战场横冲直撞。
A fierce fire elemental, able to morph into various fiery forms and charge across the battlefield with devastating force.

被动地，赤焰之灵不会使用通常的普通攻击，只会循环使用三种变形技能。
主动发动时，赤焰之灵变化为熔岩尖刺，在距离最远的敌方头顶落下，对其造成150% ATK的伤害，并击倒2秒。

Passive. Flame Warden doesn't use normal attacks. Instead, it cycles through three transformation skills.
Active. Flame Warden transforms into a lava spike that crashes down on the farthest enemy, dealing 150% ATK damage and knocking them down for 2s.
冲向覆盖最多敌人的位置，将周身盘旋的3枚火焰碎片爆出至周围1格，旋转一周后收回身边，火焰碎片在爆出时和每次与敌人碰撞时都会造成100% ATK的伤害。

Charges into the area with the most enemies and launches 3 fire shards in a 1-tile radius. The shards circle the battlefield once before returning to Flame Warden, dealing 100% ATK damage on launch and each time they hit an enemy.
赤焰之灵变形为熔岩弹球，随后依次跳跃砸向每个敌人，对目标敌人造成200% ATK伤害。
Flame Warden transforms into a lava ball that bounces between enemies, striking each enemy and dealing 200% ATK damage.
被动地，赤焰之灵处于霸体状态，且受到的魔法伤害降低90%。
Passive. The Flame Warden remains unaffected and takes 90% less magic damage.
木属性的高等元素精灵。使用叶片和藤曼变化成为不同的形态。
A strong wood elemental, able to morph into various plant-based forms.

被动地，树木之心不会使用通常的普通攻击，只会循环使用两种变形技能。
主动发动时，树木之心向最近的敌人射出藤蔓，将其定身在原地，每秒造成50% ATK伤害并吸取等量生命值，持续3秒。

Passive. Woodheart doesn't use normal attacks. Instead, it cycles through two transformation skills.
Active. Woodheart shoots vines at the nearest enemy, immobilizing them. The vines deal 50% ATK damage per second and drain an equal amount of HP for 3s.
延伸藤蔓，生长为7格大小的荆棘丛林，范围内的敌方每秒受到30% ATK伤害，受到近距离伤害时，利用尖刺进行反击对其造成20% ATK伤害，持续5秒。

Unleashes vines that spread into a 7-tile thorny thicket. Enemies in the thicket take 30% ATK damage per second. If the thicket takes melee damage, it strikes back with its thorns, dealing 20% ATK damage. Lasts 5s.
受到最后一击时，树木之心会与最虚弱的友方共生，在其表面形成树甲，使其每秒获得30% ATK的治疗，并使其受到的伤害降低15%，持续10秒。持续时间结束后，树木之心会返回战场并拥有30%最大生命值，每次被击败都会使共生时间延长20秒。

When taking a fatal blow, Woodheart links with the weakest ally, forming a bark shield around them for 10s. The shield heals the ally for 30% ATK HP per second and reduces their damage taken by 15%. After the shield expires, Woodheart returns to the battlefield with 30% max HP. Each time Woodheart is defeated again, the shield's duration is extended by 20s.
被动地，树木之心受到的魔法伤害降低90%并处于霸体状态。
Passive. Woodheart takes 90% less magic damage and becomes unaffected.
水属性的高等元素精灵。能够化为液体并重塑自身形态。
A powerful water elemental, capable of dissolving into liquid and reshaping itself at will.

被动地，深水之心不会使用通常的普通攻击，只会循环使用两种变形技能。
主动发动时，深水之心化身为一道水穹顶，出现在距离最近的敌人的位置，将其周围一格的敌人定身在原地并每秒造成40% ATK伤害，持续3秒，期间深水之心处于无敌状态。

Passive. Deepheart doesn't use normal attacks. Instead, it cycles through two transformation skills.
When actively cast, Deepheart transforms into a water dome at the nearest enemy's location. Adjacent enemies become immobilized and take 40% ATK damage per second for 3s. During this time, Deepheart is invincible.
在敌方最密集区域形成7格范围的漩涡，每0.5秒对范围内的敌人造成25% ATK伤害，并将其牵扯至漩涡中心。溅起的水花将生成3道初级水元素，继承自身50%的基础属性，且只会释放普攻，持续8秒，持续时间结束时，分裂体承受伤害的70%将传递给水元素。

Summons a 7-tile vortex in the area with the most enemies. Every 0.5s, the vortex deals 25% ATK damage and pulls enemies towards its center. The vortex also spawns 3 lesser water elementals that inherit 50% of Deepheart's basic stats. These elementals use normal attacks only and last for 8s. At the end of their duration, 70% of the damage they took is inflicted upon Deepheart.
被动地，深水之心受到的魔法伤害降低90%并处于霸体状态。
Passive. Deepheart takes 90% less magic damage and becomes unaffected.
一种神奇的丛林生物，能躲避敌人的攻击，或是使用念力把敌人抛向远处。
An extraordinary forest creature with exceptional evasion skills, capable of gracefully evading enemy attacks or using psychic abilities to forcefully hurl adversaries aside.
用念力将1名敌人抓取到半空中，然后投掷至朝距离自己较远的1个地图格。投掷落地时，对被投掷者及其邻格的敌人造成200% ATK的伤害，并使被投掷者定身2秒。
Throws an enemy further away to distant tiles using psychic power, dealing 200% ATK damage to the target and adjacent enemies. The thrown enemy is immobilized for 2s.
受到伤害时，免疫这次伤害并闪现至距离敌人较远的格子，使伤害来源在2秒内降低70%移动速度，每5秒至多生效1次。如果受到伤害前，处于定身、沉默或眩晕状态，本技能暂时失效。

When attacked, gains immunity to the damage and flashes to a tile farther from the enemy, reducing the attacker's movement speed by 70% for 2s. This effect can only be triggered once every 5s. Unable to use when immobilized, silenced or stunned before being attacked.
念力强大的异变腐化生物，不仅能躲避敌人的攻击，还能将多名敌人同时抛向远处。
A powerful corrupted creature with psychic abilities, adept at evading attacks and throwing enemies aside.
用念力将2名敌人抓取到半空中，然后分别投掷至朝距离自己较远的1个地图格。投掷落地时，对被投掷者以及邻格的敌人造成200% ATK的伤害，并使被投掷者定身3秒。
Throws two enemies further away to distant tiles using psychic power respectively, dealing 200% ATK damage to the target and adjacent enemies. The thrown enemies are immobilized for 3s.
受到伤害时，免疫这次伤害并闪现至距离敌人较远的格子，使伤害来源在2秒内降低70%移动速度，每5秒至多生效1次。如果受到伤害前，处于定身、沉默或眩晕状态，本技能暂时失效。

When attacked, gains immunity to the damage and flashes to a tile farther from the enemy, reducing the attacker's movement speed by 70% for 2s. This effect can only be triggered once every 5s. Unable to use when immobilized, silenced or stunned before being attacked.
一种神奇的丛林生物，灵巧敏捷，能躲避敌人的攻击。
A dexterous and agile forest creature who can easily evade enemy attacks.
治疗所有友军-20% HP的生命，使所有“丛林生物”下一次“幻灵舞步”的触发不受生效间隔的限制。
Heals all allies by -20% HP, resetting the cooldown of Phantom Dance of forest creatures.
受到伤害时，免疫这次伤害并闪现至距离敌人较远的格子，使伤害来源在2秒内降低70%移动速度，每5秒至多生效1次。本技能在被定身、沉默、眩晕时无法使用。

When attacked, gains immunity to the damage and flashes to a tile farther from the enemy, reducing the attacker's movement speed by 70% for 2s. The effect can be triggered once every 5s. Unable to use when immobilized, silenced, or stunned.
迈萨林德中少见的稀有异种，不仅能躲避敌人的攻击，还能提高友军的攻击速度。
A rare Mysalind species. It can evade enemy attacks and increase the ATK SPD of allies.
治疗所有友军-20% HP的生命、使他们在3秒内提升40点攻击速度，使所有“丛林生物”下一次“幻灵舞步”的触发不受生效间隔的限制。
Heals all allies by -20% HP, increasing their ATK SPD by 40 for 3s, and resetting the cooldown of Phantom Dance of forest creatures.
受到伤害时，免疫这次伤害并闪现至距离敌人较远的格子，使伤害来源在2秒内降低70%移动速度，每5秒至多生效1次。本技能在被定身、沉默、眩晕时无法使用。

When attacked, gains immunity to the damage and flashes to a tile farther from the enemy, reducing the attacker's movement speed by 70% for 2s. The effect can be triggered once every 5s. Unable to use when immobilized, silenced, or stunned.
一种神奇的丛林生物，擅长吸取敌人的能量，能在躲避敌人攻击的同时制造幻影欺骗敌人。
This mystical forest creature absorbs energy from its enemies, using illusions to deceive them while dodging their attacks.
向敌方最密集区域抛出大孢子团，使7格范围内敌人受到360% ATK伤害并每秒损失100点能量，持续3秒。
Hurls a large cluster of spores at the area with the most enemies, dealing 360% ATK damage to enemies within 7 tiles and causing them to lose 100 Energy per second for 3s.
受到伤害时，免疫这次伤害并闪现至距离敌人较远的格子，并在原位置制造幻影欺骗敌人，每10秒至多生效1次。本技能在被定身、沉默、眩晕时无法使用，幻影继承本体50%生命值和100%的其他属性，只会使用普通攻击且造成的伤害下降50%，幻影消失时将对周围1格敌人造成200% ATK伤害。

When attacked, gains immunity to the damage and flashes to a tile farther from the enemy, leaving behind a phantom to confuse enemies. The effect can be triggered once every 10s. Cannot be triggered when immobilized, silenced, or stunned. The phantom inherits 50% of the caster's HP and 100% of the caster's other stats, and it only performs normal attacks with 50% reduced damage. Upon disappearing, it deals 200% ATK damage to adjacent enemies.
一种神奇的丛林生物，擅长吸取敌人的能量，能在躲避敌人攻击的同时制造幻影欺骗敌人。
This mystical forest creature absorbs energy from its enemies, using illusions to deceive them while dodging their attacks.
向敌方最密集区域抛出大孢子团，使7格范围内敌人受到360% ATK伤害并每秒损失100点能量，持续3秒。
Hurls a large cluster of spores at the area with the most enemies, dealing 360% ATK damage to enemies within 7 tiles and causing them to lose 100 Energy per second for 3s.
受到伤害时，免疫这次伤害并闪现至距离敌人较远的格子，并在原位置制造幻影欺骗敌人，每10秒至多生效1次。本技能在被定身、沉默、眩晕时无法使用，幻影继承本体50%生命值和100%的其他属性，只会使用普通攻击且造成的伤害下降50%，幻影消失时将对周围1格敌人造成200% ATK伤害。

一名擅长终结敌人的游侠，可以提高自身暴击。
A Rogue skilled at eliminating enemies and increasing his own Crit.
瞬身到最虚弱的敌人背后进行3次斩击，每次造成40% ATK伤害，然后附带最后一击造成160% ATK的伤害。若自身已“狂热”，则最后一击会附加目标已损生命值20%的伤害。额外伤害不超过自身300% ATK。

Teleports near the weakest enemy and initiates 3 strikes from behind, with each strike dealing 40% ATK damage. Follows up with a heavy strike that deals 160% ATK damage. If under the Frenzy effect, the heavy strike deals extra damage equal to 20% of the target's lost HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 300% ATK.
当有友军被击败时，若自身生命值大于75%，则进入“狂热”状态。使自身提高40点暴击和25点暴击增幅，且每次普通攻击将会附加目标已损生命值12%的额外伤害，直至战斗结束。额外伤害不超过自身200% ATK。

Gains the Frenzy effect if HP ratio is greater than 75% when an ally is defeated, increasing Crit by 40 and Crit DMG Boost by 25. Normal attacks deal additional damage equal to 12% of the target's lost HP until the battle ends. The additional damage cannot exceed 200% ATK.
对目标造成160% ATK伤害，并降低目标15点暴击抗性，持续5秒。若自身已“狂热”，则降低暴击抗性的效果提高至40。
Deals 160% ATK damage, and reduces the target's Crit Resist by 15 for 5s. If under the Frenzy effect, he can reduce the target's Crit Resist by 40.
一名擅长持久战的战士，能提高自身攻击并且回复生命。
A Warrior skilled at war of attrition, increasing his own ATK, and recovering his own HP.
对目标进行3次斩击，每次造成40% ATK伤害，随后挥出一道剑气对目标及其身后直线上的敌人造成160% ATK的伤害。若自身已“狂热”，则回复自身20%已损生命值。

Initiates 3 strikes to the target, with each strike dealing 40% ATK damage. Then he generates a sword shock, dealing 160% ATK damage to the enemies in a line behind. If under the Frenzy effect, recovers 20% of his lost HP.

获得一个150% ATK护盾，持续5秒。若自身已“狂热”，则护盾效果提升至200%。
Gains 150% ATK shield for 5s. If under the Frenzy effect, the shield's effects are increased to 200%.
战斗时会燃烧自己的生命为队友增幅的祭司。
A devoted priestess who boosts allies' stats by sacrificing their own HP during battle.
为所有友方单位增加40%攻击力以及40点生命汲取，持续10秒。
Increases all allies' ATK by 40% and Life Drain by 40 for 10s.

The ritual lasts for 8s, converting 3.5% of max HP into 80 Energy per second. Up to 1 rituals can be completed in total, with each increasing all allies' Haste by 20 for the rest of the battle. The ritual is interrupted immediately if the shield breaks.

冲向累积造成伤害最高的敌人，对其进行4段爪击，每段造成135% ATK伤害，最后一段爪击还将眩晕目标3秒。
Charges at the enemy who dealt the most damage, performing 4 claw strikes, each dealing 135% ATK damage. The final strike also stuns the target for 3s.

擅于使用爆弹和炸药造成范围伤害的矮人，可以驾驶矮人机械战斗。
A dwarf cannoneer skilled in AoE attacks using bombs and dynamite. Also capable of piloting dwarf machines in battle.
矮人在战斗中会主动驾驶无人的矮人机械，在驾驶时给机械提升自身攻击力、护甲和魔抗的50%，在驾驶时矮人本体不会受到伤害和控制效果，在驾驶的机械被击败后会被弹射出驾驶席。

During combat, a dwarf will always seek out and operate any unmanned dwarf machine, increasing the machine's ATK, Physical DEF, and Magic DEF by 50% upon taking control. While inside the machine, the dwarf is immune to damage and control effects. If the machine is destroyed, the dwarf is ejected.
普通攻击会对目标周围1格造成30%的溅射伤害，并且优先选择攻击范围内能溅射最多敌人的目标。
Deals 30% splash damage to enemies within 1 tile of the target with normal attacks. Normal attacks prioritize targets surrounded by the most nearby enemies.
发射爆炸半径2格的火炮，对目标格及半径1格内敌人造成400% ATK伤害，对距离中心2格的敌人造成200% ATK伤害，受到伤害的敌人在10秒内护甲降低15%。

Fires a cannon that hits a 2-tile radius, dealing 400% ATK damage to enemies on the target tile and within 1 tiles of it, and 200% ATK damage to enemies 2 tiles away. The cannon hit also reduces affected enemies' Phys DEF by 15% for 10s.
擅于在战场上制造机械的矮人，可以驾驶矮人机械战斗。
A dwarf mechanic who builds and pilots dwarf machines in battle.

When no enemies are nearby, lunges at the target, dealing 250% ATK damage and stunning them for 1s.

A spiky sandbeast with sharp teeth who can charge at enemies when a battle begins.
战斗开始时，向前方发起冲锋直至地图边缘，击飞命中的敌人并造成190% ATK伤害，并使其眩晕3秒；若没有命中敌人，则进入发怒状态，急速提高20点，造成伤害增加20%且受到伤害降低20%。

Charges forward to the edge of the battlefield when a battle starts, dealing 190% ATK damage to enemies in its path, knocking them into the air, then stunning them for 3s. Becomes enraged if the charge hits no enemies, increasing Haste by 20 and damage dealt by 20%, reducing the damage taken by 20%.
连续攻击一名敌人3次，分别造成2次140% ATK伤害和1次200% ATK伤害。该攻击会使目标进入流血状态，每秒受到30% ATK伤害，持续5秒。
Attacks an enemy 3 times and makes them bleed, dealing 140% ATK damage twice and 200% ATK damage once. The bleeding target takes 30% ATK damage per second for 5s.
一名擅长在前线厮斗的战士，与其他野狼结伴行动时获得加强。
A talented Warrior-skirmisher for the front lines. Gains a bonus when acting together with other wolves.
对一名敌人造成100% ATK伤害，并附加目标最大生命值4%的额外伤害。本技能造成伤害的50%将会转化为自身的护盾，持续4秒。
Deals 100% ATK damage to 1 enemy and additional damage equal to 4% of the target's max HP. Converts 50% of the damage dealt by this skill into shield for 4s.
当相邻的格子上存在友方野狼同伴时，自身获得25点生命汲取。
Gains 25 Life Drain if an allied Wolf Companion is on an adjacent tile.
迅猛的鸟类，会在危险时蓄势腾飞，随后俯冲重击敌人。
A fierce bird gathers its strength in times of danger, launching into the sky before diving down to strike with deadly force.
冲向累积造成伤害最高的敌人，对其进行4段爪击，每段造成135% ATK伤害，最后一段爪击还将眩晕目标3秒。
Charges at the enemy who dealt the most damage, performing 4 claw strikes, each dealing 135% ATK damage. The final strike also stuns the target for 3s.
战斗开始时，冲刺至对称格子并击飞该格子内的敌人，造成320% ATK伤害；被动地，当生命值比例低于40%时，在原地蓄势5秒，随后绕着战场飞行，期间处于无敌状态并恢复共100%已损失生命值，至少持续4秒，随后冲向敌人最密集的区域，击飞1格范围内的敌人并造成320% ATK伤害。

When a battle starts, charges at the enemy on the symmetrical tile, knocking them into the air and dealing 320% ATK damage.
Passive. When HP ratio falls below 40%, builds momentum in place for 5s before soaring into the air, becoming invincible and restoring 100% of lost HP. After hovering for at least 4s, swoops toward the area with the most enemies, knocking enemies within 1 tile of the target tile into the air and dealing 320% ATK damage.
一名身强体壮的叶角熊部落战士，生命值降低时会持续回复生命值，擅长利用友军咕布林并对后排的敌人造成伤害效果。
A powerful Warrior of the Hornleaf Bear Tribe that constantly recovers HP during battles. Commands allied gruglins to deal damage to backline enemies.
将面前1格扇形范围的所有敌人和友军咕布林向后击退2格，对被命中和击退路径上的敌人造成350% ATK伤害。若击退的是友军咕布林，则会对该咕布林和其击退路径上的敌人额外附加一段伤害，额外伤害量等同于被击退的咕布林30%的最大生命值。

Knocks back all the enemies or allied gruglins within a 1-tile arc by 2 tiles, dealing 350% ATK damage to enemies hit and on the way. When an allied gruglin is knocked back, deals additional damage equal to 30% of max HP of the gruglin to both the gruglin and the enemy hit on the way.
自身生命值百分比降低至50%以下时，每1秒恢复8%的最大生命值，持续6秒，期间护甲提高50%。该效果每场战斗只会触发1次。
When the HP ratio falls below 50%, recovers 8% of max HP every 1s for 6s, during which Phys DEF is increased by 50%. Triggered up to 1 time per battle.
荧荧花守卫的一种，能够造成百分比伤害，当快速生长后，可增强自身护甲和魔抗。
A Bloom Guard skilled at dealing percentage damage and boosting Phys DEF and Magic DEF after rapid growth.
对目标造成自身最大20% HP的伤害。若自身已“生长”，则同时恢复等量生命值。
Deals <HP> 20% damage to the target. Recovers the same amount of HP if Growth is active.
生命值首次低于60%时，自身将“生长”直至战斗结束。“生长”后增加自身20%的护甲和30%魔抗。
When HP ratio falls below 60% for the first time, grants Growth to itself until the battle ends. Growth increases Phys DEF by 20% and Magic DEF by 30%.
一种神奇的丛林生物，擅长吸取敌人的能量，能在躲避敌人攻击的同时制造幻影欺骗敌人。
This mystical forest creature absorbs energy from its enemies, using illusions to deceive them while dodging their attacks.
向敌方最密集区域抛出大孢子团，使7格范围内敌人受到360% ATK伤害并每秒损失100点能量，持续3秒。
Hurls a large cluster of spores at the area with the most enemies, dealing 360% ATK damage to enemies within 7 tiles and causing them to lose 100 Energy per second for 3s.
受到伤害时，免疫这次伤害并闪现至距离敌人较远的格子，并在原位置制造幻影欺骗敌人，每10秒至多生效1次。本技能在被定身、沉默、眩晕时无法使用，幻影继承本体50%生命值和100%的其他属性，只会使用普通攻击且造成的伤害下降50%，幻影消失时将对周围1格敌人造成200% ATK伤害。

When attacked, gains immunity to the damage and flashes to a tile farther from the enemy, leaving behind a phantom to confuse enemies. The effect can be triggered once every 10s. Cannot be triggered when immobilized, silenced, or stunned. The phantom inherits 50% of the caster's HP and 100% of the caster's other stats, and it only performs normal attacks with 50% reduced damage. Upon disappearing, it deals 200% ATK damage to adjacent enemies.
一种神奇的丛林生物，通过弹跳来回移动，能在躲避敌人攻击的同时发起攻击。
This mystical forest creature hops around, striking its enemies while dodging their attacks.
使自身进入喷发状态，接下来3次跳跃落地时，向周围一格喷洒毒雾，对范围内的敌人造成100% ATK伤害，并降低-50%移动速度，持续3秒。
Enters eruption mode. For the next 3 jumps, sprays toxic mist upon landing, dealing 100% ATK damage to nearby enemies and reducing their movement speed by -50% for 3s.
受到伤害时，免疫这次伤害并闪现至距离最远的敌人脚下，将其顶飞1秒，且使伤害来源在2秒内降低70%移动速度，每10秒至多生效1次。本技能在被定身、沉默、眩晕时无法使用。

When attacked, gains immunity to the damage and flashes to the farthest enemy, knocking them into the air for 1s, and reducing the attacker's movement speed by 70% for 2s. The effect can be triggered once every 10s. Unable to use when immobilized, silenced, or stunned.
一名拥有庞大身躯的战士，能够攻击大范围敌人，并且可以将敌人拉至身前。
A giant Mistal Warrior skilled at dealing AoE damage to enemies and pulling them near.
挥舞双爪对面前1格扇形范围内的所有敌人造成6次伤害，前5次造成100% ATK伤害，第6次造成300% ATK伤害，随后自身提高25%攻击力，持续10秒。

Swings the claws and attacks all enemies within 1 tile of the frontal area 6 times. The first 5 attacks deal 100% ATK damage, and the last deals 300% ATK damage. After the skill takes effect, gains 25% ATK for 10s.
对一名敌人及其周围2格范围内的所有敌人造成130% ATK伤害，并使其眩晕2秒。
Deals 130% ATK damage to a target and surrounding enemies within 2 tiles, and stuns them for 2s.
将一名最远的敌人拉到自身面前，并对其造成200% ATK伤害。
Pulls 1 farthest enemy near, and deals 200% ATK damage.
将神圣与邪恶的力量融为一体的梦魇，能够召唤翼魔协助自己作战。
A nightmare embodying the power of light and darkness that's capable of summoning winged creatures to help itself in battle.
堕神之颅稍作蓄力后，朝前方长度为10格的扇形区域扫射出一道激光，对激光触碰到的所有敌人造成260% ATK的伤害。

彪悍的重装战士首领，可以在战斗中源源不断地召集援军。

快速旋转大剑，形成剑刃风暴，每0.25秒对周围2格内的所有敌人造成50% ATK伤害，持续2.5秒。技能释放完毕后一段时间内，自身无法攻击或释放技能。

Quickly spins the broadsword, generates a blade storm, and deals 50% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles every 0.25s for 2.5s. Unable to attack or cast skills in several seconds after casting the skill.
战斗中，自身生命值比例首次低于50%时，立即喝下特饮，恢复50% HP的生命值，并永久强化自身的普通攻击，使普通攻击变为对自己前方1格范围内的最多3名敌人同时造成175% ATK伤害。在异界迷宫玩法中，恢复生命值效果将会改为获得10% HP的护盾，持续15秒。

Drinks a special drink when his HP ratio first falls below 50% in battle to recover 50% HP HP and permanently upgrades normal attacks to deal simultaneous damage of 175% ATK to up to 3 enemies within 1 tile in front. When fighting in Arcane Labyrinth, gains a 10% HP shield for 15s instead of recovering HP.
战斗中，自身从战斗第12秒起呼叫盗匪团成员进行支援。初始召唤4名盗匪团成员。每当场上的盗匪团成员小于等于2名时，会再次使用本技能，并补足至4名成员。整场战斗中最多召唤10名盗匪团成员。

After 12s of a battle, calls the bandits members for help, and summons 4 members at first. When the number of bandits members on the battlefield is not higher than 2, casts the skill again, and summons 4 members in total to the battlefield. Summons up to 10 members during the battle.
跳跃到一名敌人身后，并对自身周围2格内所有敌人造成180% ATK伤害。
Jumps behind an enemy, and deals 180% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles.
一名擅长造成大范围伤害和魅惑的法师，并且可以在战斗中召唤友军。
A Bloom Mage skilled at dealing AoE damage to enemies, charming them, and summoning allies.
对始祖魔花所在半场的所有敌人造成100% ATK伤害，随后魅惑其中生命值百分比低于50%的敌人4秒，期间仅会使用普通攻击。
Deals 100% ATK damage to all enemies on the Elderbloom's side of the battlefield, then charms enemies who have less than 50% HP for 4s, making them only use normal attacks during this time.
召唤5只"分生孢子"攻击敌人，自身进入"花苞"状态。该状态下自身处于无敌状态并且不会进行攻击，而是每3秒为"分生孢子"恢复75% ATK生命值。每只"分生孢子"被击败时自身将失去10% HP的生命值。若所有"分生孢子"被击败，自身将结束"花苞"状态。

Summons 5 conidia that attack enemies, then enters a bud state. Cannot attack in this state, and can only restore 75% ATK HP for each conidium every 3s; becomes invincible while in "bud" state, but loses 10% HP HP whenever a conidium is defeated. The "bud" state ends when all conidia are defeated.
释放"迷雾"，每1秒对周围2格内的所有敌人造成40% ATK伤害，持续10秒。敌人每连续处在"迷雾"中1秒，其受到的"迷雾"伤害便会提升10%，且降低5%攻击力，直至离开"迷雾"范围。

Releases Miasma that deals 40% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles every 1s for 10s. For every 1s an enemy is inside the Miasma, they take an additional 10% damage from the Miasma, and their ATK is lowered by 5% until they leave the Miasma.
一名乘着战车在场上横冲直撞的暴君，拥有可怕的伤害制造能力。
A gruglin tyrant rampaging the battlefield on a chariot, skilled at dealing a terrifying amount of damage.
驾驶战车在战场上快速冲锋，绕场一周后返回原位。战车行进过程中会对途经敌人造成240% ATK伤害，并将其击倒。技能释放期间，自身处于无敌状态。
Circles the field on a chariot, dealing 240% ATK damage to enemies in the path and knocking them down. Becomes invincible while during Ultimate.
对最近敌人所在的方向用力挥鞭，对沿途所有敌人造成180% ATK伤害，并将其向两侧击退1格。
Swings a whip in the direction of the nearest enemy, dealing 180% ATK damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back 1 tile to either side.
强迫部下们超负荷战斗，在4秒内对最近的1名敌人进行32次攻击，每次攻击造成25% ATK伤害。
Forces subordinates to fight while overloaded, attacking the nearest enemy 32 times within 4s, dealing 25% ATK damage with each attack.
咕布林战车大王受到的除终极技能之外的伤害降低30%。
Reduces all non-Ultimate damage taken by 30%.
荧荧花一族领袖，能够造成大范围伤害，并且在战斗中能够不断提升能力。
A Bloom matriarch skilled at dealing AoE damage with continuously improving abilities in battles.

战斗开始的第10秒，30秒，45秒自身会“生长”，每次“生长”会使自身两侧的一朵花苏醒并参与战斗，第三次“生长”后会完全展开翅膀漂浮至半空中直至战斗结束。从战斗开始每隔15秒会主动释放终极技能，展开翅膀击退附近敌人，随后挥动翅膀引起气流，使所有敌人被击退至对方场地边缘并造成150% ATK伤害，并根据“生长”次数向所有敌人发射魔法弹，每枚魔法弹造成60% ATK伤害。若已“生长”1次发射共计5枚魔法弹，已“生长”2次发射共计10枚魔法弹，已“生长”3次发射共计30枚魔法弹。

Grows 10s, 30s, and 45s into a battle. Each Growth will awaken a flower on both sides of itself and participate in the battle. After the third Growth, it fully spreads its wings and floats in the air until the battle ends. Every 15s after a battle starts, it actively casts its Ultimate, spreading its wings to knockback nearby enemies, and then waving its wings to knock back enemies to the edge of their field and deal 150% ATK damage. A number of magic missiles, each dealing 60% ATK damage, are launched at enemies according to the number of Growths. At 1, 2, and 3 Growths, 5, 10, and 30 magic missiles are launched respectively.
短暂蓄力后，向敌人最多的区域投射一枚魔法炮弹，对附近2格范围内的敌人造成120% ATK伤害，并留下一片迷雾持续5秒，在迷雾中的敌人获得能量的效率下降40%。

After charging for a brief moment, launches a magic cannonball at the area with the most enemies, dealing 120% ATK damage to all enemies within 2 tiles and creating a miasma that lasts for 5s, reducing enemies' Energy acquisition efficiency in the miasma by 40%.
三只花朵随着自身“生长”依次苏醒，每隔6秒，自身所有苏醒的花朵会发射特殊魔法弹攻击特殊目标，造成120% ATK伤害并附加不同效果。第一朵花攻击敌方场上攻击力最高的敌人，降低40%攻击，持续4秒。第二朵花攻击场上能量最高的敌人，扣除其600点能量。第三朵花攻击场上最虚弱的敌人，附加30%目标已损生命值的魔法伤害。

Three flowers awaken sequentially according to the Growth stage. Every 6s, all awakened flowers attack special targets with special magic bullets, dealing 120% ATK damage and inflicting different effects. The first flower attacks the enemy with the highest ATK on the enemy's side of the field and reduces their ATK by 40% for 4s. The second flower attacks the enemy with the most Energy on the field and reduces their Energy by 600. The third flower attacks the weakest enemy on the field and deals additional magic damage equal to 30% of the target's lost HP.
在战斗的第30秒“生长”完成，提升60点暴击直至战斗结束。
30s into a battle, completes all growth stages and gains 60 Crit until the battle ends.
某种远古造物，能够造成大范围伤害，打乱敌人阵型并且对物理伤害有显著的减免能力。
An ancient creation skilled at dealing AoE damage to enemies, and disrupting enemy formations, highly resistant to all forms of physical damage.
将自身周围2格内的敌人击退并造成250% ATK伤害，随后引发3次地震波，每次使1范围内的敌人击退并造成1.5 ATK伤害。
Knocks back enemies within 2 surrounding tiles and deals 250% ATK damage. Releases 3 shock waves, knocking back enemies within a range of 1 each time and dealing 1.5 ATK damage to them.
投掷一枚巨石，对目标及其周围1格内的敌人造成360% ATK伤害并眩晕，持续3秒。
Throws a boulder, dealing 360% ATK damage to the target and enemies within 1 tile and stunning them for 3s.
向最远的敌人发射一条激光射线，对被命中的敌人造成400% ATK伤害，随后残留一片灼烧区域，每0.25秒对区域内的敌人造成0.8 ATK伤害，持续1.25秒。
Shoots a laser at the farthest enemy, dealing 400% ATK damage to enemies hit and leaving behind a burning trail. Every 0.25s, deals 0.8 ATK damage to enemies within this area. Lasts for 1.25s.
进入防御姿态，期间免疫物理伤害，持续6秒。
Enters a defensive stance, becoming immune to physical damage for 6s.
贤者伊米尔被邪恶魔法影响变化而成的堕落形态，具有惊人的蛮力，惧怕控制类魔法。
Warped by dark magic, Eomir morphs into a corrupted being, wielding incredible brute force but vulnerable to spells with control effects.
伊米尔抓起邻近的1名敌人，并且不断地砸向地面，每次砸击对目标以及目标附近的敌人造成200% ATK伤害。连续砸击时，每次砸击伤害会上升5%，直至技能被打断或者目标被击败。

Grabs 1 nearby enemy and keeps smashing them on the ground, dealing 200% ATK damage to the target and nearby enemies with each smash. The damage of each smash increases by 5% with each consecutive smash until the skill is interrupted or the target is defeated.
伊米尔选定敌人较多的一个地点，在蓄力一段时间后跳向这个地点，在落地时对周围2格内的敌人造成300% ATK的伤害并击飞他们。伊米尔在蓄力时可被打断，但在跳起后免疫控制效果。

Selects a location with many enemies, then charges up briefly and leaps to this location, dealing 300% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles when landing and knocking them into the air. Eomir can be interrupted while charging, but is immune to control effects while leaping.
伊米尔免疫击飞和击退效果，但会受到控制效果的影响，控制效果对伊米尔的持续时间下降50%。
Cannot be knocked into the air or knocked back. Although other control effects still affect him, their duration is reduced by 50%.
一头凶悍的独眼狼王，会躲入迷雾中，并召唤小狼攻击处于迷雾中的敌人。
A formidable one-eyed Wolf King, skilled at hiding in mist and summoning wolf packs to attack enemies within.
战斗开始的第10、40、70秒，战场出现迷雾，狼王短暂消失后会再次出现，驱散自身1格内的迷雾，并召唤狼群攻击迷雾中的敌人。每次造成30% ATK的伤害并使目标获得1层“流血”，持续10秒，每层“流血”每秒对目标造成3% ATK伤害，最多叠加6层。迷雾会在出现20秒后消失，处于迷雾中角色的伤害类技能有70%概率被狼王闪避。

At the first 10s, 40s, and 70s in the battle, the mist appears on the battlefield. The Wolf King disappears briefly before reappearing to dispel the mist within 1 tile. Summons the wolf pack to attack the enemies in the mist. For each hit, he deals 30% ATK damage and inflicts a stack of bleed for 10s. Each bleed stack deals 3% ATK damage per second to the target, up to 6 stacks. The mist disappears in 20s after appearing. The Wolf King has a 70% chance to dodge the damage skills from enemies within the mist.
冲向距离最远的目标，造成250% ATK伤害，对超过2格的目标会额外造成30% ATK伤害。迷雾存在期间，该技能变为召唤3只幻影狼冲向目标，分别造成100% ATK伤害。
Dashes to the farthest target, dealing 250% ATK damage. Deals 30% ATK extra damage to the target beyond 2 tiles. Summons 3 spectral wolves if the mist exists, each dealing 100% ATK damage.
对前方1格扇形区域的目标先造成2次120% ATK伤害，再造成1格范围150% ATK伤害并打断目标。
Deals 120% ATK damage twice to the targets within a 1-tile arc in front. Then deals 150% ATK damage to adjacent enemies and interrupts them.
每击败一个非召唤物的敌方角色，自身获得20点急速和20%的护甲和魔抗，该效果最多叠加5层。
Gains 20 Haste and 20% Phys DEF and Magic DEF upon defeating an enemy hero, up to 5 stacks.
叶角熊部落的统治者，极其嗜好蜂蜜。它会把附魔的蜂蜜涂抹在敌人身上，然后呼唤蜂群吞没敌人。
The ruler of the Hornleaf Bear Tribe, known for an insatiable love for honey. Proficient in enchanting honey to drench enemies and summoning swarms to consume them.
叶角熊王呼唤蜂群，在3秒内对每个“沾上蜂蜜”的敌人每秒造成25% ATK伤害。场上所有敌方英雄都“沾上蜂蜜”时，叶角熊王立刻呼唤超大蜂群，直至战斗结束对所有敌人每秒造成100% ATK伤害。

Summons a swarm that deals 25% ATK damage per second to each enemy covered in honey for 3s. When all enemy heroes are marked with honey, a mega swarm is summoned, dealing 100% ATK damage per second till the end of the battle.
叶角熊王向1名没有“沾上蜂蜜”的敌人扔出一团蜂蜜，对其造成100% ATK伤害，并使其“沾上蜂蜜”直至战斗结束。因叶角熊王的任意技能“沾上蜂蜜”的角色，受到的治疗效果下降50%，此状态不可驱散。
Throws honey at an enemy, marking them until the end of the battle and dealing 100% ATK damage. The healing received by the marked enemy is reduced by 50% and cannot be dispelled.

当自己的邻格存在敌人时，叶角熊王朝自己周围泼洒蜂蜜，对邻格的所有敌人造成50% ATK伤害，并使他们“沾上蜂蜜”。
当自己的邻格没有敌人时，叶角熊王锤击地面，对场上的所有敌人造成200% ATK伤害。

Throws honey at enemies in adjacent tiles, dealing 50% ATK damage and marking them.
Smashes the ground when there are no enemies in adjacent tiles, dealing 200% ATK damage to all enemies.
叶角熊王揉制1枚滚球，将滚球推向敌人，滚球对沿途的所有敌人各造成120% ATK伤害。
Makes and pulls a Terraball towards the enemy, dealing 120% ATK damage to all enemies in its path.
一名摧枯拉朽的远古守护者，能够用压倒性的力量与魔法毁灭进犯之敌。
A formidable ancient guardian capable of unleashing devastating power and magic to eliminate any approaching enemies.
从巨环中汇聚强大的远古能量，短暂蓄力后，对全场敌人造成6次80% ATK伤害。释放完成后，自身会进入一段时间的瘫痪状态。
Charges up the powerful ancient energy and deals 80% ATK damage 6 times to all the enemies. Enters a state of paralysis for a while after casting the skill.
举起巨锤蓄力，随后重重砸向地面，对全场敌人造成350% ATK伤害。若目标实际受到了来自本技能的伤害，则会被击倒6秒，并降低50点急速。急速降低的效果持续15秒，且不可叠加。上述效果可以被护盾抵挡。

Charges a giant hammer to smash the ground, dealing 350% ATK damage to all enemies. The target hit will be knocked down for 6s and have their Haste reduced by 50 if they receive the skill damage. The Haste reduction effect lasts for 15s and cannot be stacked. This effect can be blocked by shields.
进行一次横扫，对全场所有敌人造成200% ATK伤害，并对其施加“撕裂”，使其在接下来6秒内每秒流失5%最大生命值。
Sweeps and deals 200% ATK damage to all enemies, injuring them and making them lose 5% of their max HP over the next 6s.
被动地，巨型魔偶的强大能量充盈着整个战场领域，使得场上所有角色产生的护盾效果的持续时间提升100%。
Passive. Fills the battlefield with powerful energy, extending the duration of shield effects produced by all units by 100%.
深渊中的残骸骨龙，能够攻击大范围的敌人，并对敌人所在的位置持续造成负面效果。
A formidable abyssal dragon with shattered bones, capable of unleashing wide-ranging attacks and inflicting persistent debuffs upon enemies.
战斗开始后第15秒、40秒、65秒会释放此技能。技能释放时，对全场所有敌人造成3次70% ATK伤害，并对其施加一层永久存在的“深渊献祭”。每层“深渊献祭”会使目标提高10点攻击速度，但受到的伤害增加25%，该效果可叠加3次，且不可驱散。

Casts this skill at 15s, 40s and 65s after the battle starts. Deals 70% ATK damage 3 times to all enemies, inflicting them with a stack of Abyss Sacrifice. Each stack increases the target's ATK SPD by 10 but also increases the damage they receive by 25%, up to 3 stacks and can't be dispelled.
在敌人最密集区域喷吐龙息，制造一个1格范围大小、持续4秒的深渊泥潭，处于泥潭内的敌人每秒会受到35% ATK的伤害。
Unleashes a powerful dragon's breath at the area with the most enemies, creating a 1-tile abyss mire that persists for 4s. Enemies within the mire suffer continuous 35% ATK damage per second.
对最健康的2名目标释放，造成50% ATK伤害并眩晕1秒，并使其在接下来3秒内每秒流失40点能量。
Deals 50% ATK damage to the 2 healthiest targets, stunning them for 1s and draining 40 Energy over the next 3s.
战斗开始5秒后，会首次释放此技能，之后每隔20秒会再次释放。释放技能时，在所有敌人脚下位置生成一个“烙印”。烙印将会在15秒后爆炸，若爆炸前离开烙印，烙印将会消失，烙印爆炸时会对地图格上的敌人造成110% ATK伤害，并使其永久降低-10%能量获取效率和-5%攻击力，该效果最多可以叠加2次，且不可驱散。

Casts this skill for the first time in 5s after the battle starts, then casts again every 20s. Places a crest beneath each enemy, which explodes after 15s; the crest will disappear if the target leaves it before explosion. The explosion deals 110% ATK damage to the enemies, reducing their Energy gain efficiency by -10% and ATK by -5%, up to 2 stacks, and cannot be dispelled.
战斗开始5秒后，会首次释放此技能，之后每隔20秒会再次释放。释放技能时，在所有敌人脚下位置生成一个“烙印”。烙印将会在15秒后爆炸，若爆炸前离开烙印，烙印将会消失，烙印爆炸时会对地图格上的敌人造成110% ATK伤害，并使其永久降低-15%能量获取效率和-10%攻击力，该效果最多可以叠加2次，且不可驱散。

Casts this skill for the first time in 5s after the battle starts, then casts again every 20s. Places a crest beneath each enemy, which explodes after 15s; the crest will disappear if the target leaves it before explosion. The explosion deals 110% ATK damage to the enemies, reducing their Energy gain efficiency by -15% and ATK by -10%, up to 2 stacks, and cannot be dispelled.
战斗开始5秒后，会首次释放此技能，之后每隔20秒会再次释放。释放技能时，在所有敌人脚下位置生成一个“烙印”。烙印将会在15秒后爆炸，若爆炸前离开烙印，烙印将会消失，烙印爆炸时会对地图格上的敌人造成110% ATK伤害，并使其永久降低-20%能量获取效率和-15%攻击力，该效果最多可以叠加2次，且不可驱散。

Casts this skill for the first time in 5s after the battle starts, then casts again every 20s. Places a crest beneath each enemy, which explodes after 15s; the crest will disappear if the target leaves it before explosion. The explosion deals 110% ATK damage to the enemies, reducing their Energy gain efficiency by -20% and ATK by -15%, up to 2 stacks, and cannot be dispelled.
战斗开始5秒后，会首次释放此技能，之后每隔20秒会再次释放。释放技能时，在所有敌人脚下位置生成一个“烙印”。烙印将会在15秒后爆炸，若爆炸前离开烙印，烙印将会消失，烙印爆炸时会对地图格上的敌人造成110% ATK伤害，并使其永久降低-30%能量获取效率和-20%攻击力，该效果最多可以叠加2次，且不可驱散。

Casts this skill for the first time in 5s after the battle starts, then casts again every 20s. Places a crest beneath each enemy, which explodes after 15s; the crest will disappear if the target leaves it before explosion. The explosion deals 110% ATK damage to the enemies, reducing their Energy gain efficiency by -30% and ATK by -20%, up to 2 stacks, and cannot be dispelled.
战斗开始5秒后，会首次释放此技能，之后每隔20秒会再次释放。释放技能时，在所有敌人脚下位置生成一个“烙印”。烙印将会在15秒后爆炸，若爆炸前离开烙印，烙印将会消失，烙印爆炸时会对地图格上的敌人造成110% ATK伤害，并使其永久降低-40%能量获取效率和-25%攻击力，该效果最多可以叠加2次，且不可驱散。

Casts this skill for the first time in 5s after the battle starts, then casts again every 20s. Places a crest beneath each enemy, which explodes after 15s; the crest will disappear if the target leaves it before explosion.
