Passive. Gains a stack of Fury every 20s, shortening the cooldown by 5s. Resets the cooldown each time entering a frenzy status.
血薇教父，战斗中会召唤打手代替自己作战。
A foreman of the Carmine Whispers who summons henchmen to fight in his place during battle.
召唤5名随从进入战场，当这些随从都被击败后，泰西欧损失20% HP生命值。
Summons 5 bodyguards to the battlefield. When all the bodyguards are defeated, Tesio loses 20% HP HP.
激励所有友军，使其造成伤害提高20%并获得20点急速，但是受到伤害也会增加20%，持续5秒。
Motivates all allies for the next 5s, increasing their damage dealt by 20% and granting them 20 Haste. However, allies will also take 20% more damage.
战斗开始时，泰西欧携带保镖进场并处于无敌状态。泰西欧处于“激怒”状态时可以主动释放，命令保镖对最虚弱的2名敌人造成200% ATK伤害并使目标定身5秒。

When a battle starts, enters the battlefield with his bodyguards, both starting with invincibility. This skill can be actively used when Tesio is enraged. He will command his bodyguards to deal 200% ATK damage to the 2 weakest enemies and immobilize them for 5s.
泰西欧生命值比例降低至60%后进入“激怒”状态；生命值比例降低至40%后命令保镖进入战场；生命值比例降低至20%后进入“恐慌”状态，并且不再处于无敌状态。

Becomes enraged when Tesio's HP ratio drops to 60%. When Tesio's HP drops to 40%, he summons his bodyguards to the battlefield. When Tesio's HP drops to 20%, he enters the panic state and loses his Invincibility.
传说中称霸海洋的巨型领主，只回应死潮舰队至高领袖的召唤。
A mythical sea monster, rising only to the call of the Dead Tide Fleet's commander.
召唤海浪，对全体敌人造成150% ATK伤害，并使其眩晕2秒。在“暴怒”状态下，本技能改为召唤水龙卷对全体敌人造成250% ATK伤害，随后再对生命值最高的3名敌人进行一次追加攻击，造成150% ATK伤害。

Summons tidal waves to deal 150% ATK damage to all enemies and stun them for 2s. While in Rampage state, this skill transforms into a water vortex, dealing 250% ATK damage to all enemies and then performing an extra attack on the top 3 healthiest enemies, causing 150% ATK damage.

战斗开始时，塔莉莎携带四只触手一同参战，其中身前的两只触手处于战斗状态、身后的两只触手暂时在场外待命。当身前的两只触手均被击败后，身后的两只触手将会替补出战。
在四只触手被全部击败之前，塔莉莎处于无敌状态；当四只触手均被击败后，塔莉莎将会永久进入“暴怒”状态，并立即对场上所有敌人造成150% ATK伤害。

Deploys four tentacles when a battle starts, with the front two engaged in battle while the rear two are on standby. Once the front tentacles are defeated, the rear ones will fight instead.
Thalassa is invincible before the four tentacles are defeated. When all four tentacles are defeated, Thalassa will enter a permanent Rampage state and deal 150% ATK damage to all enemies.
塔莉莎的触手会使用“拍击”和“横扫”攻击敌人。“拍击”会对路径上的所有敌人造成90% ATK伤害，“横扫”会对全体敌人造成110% ATK伤害。
Thalassa's tentacles can "smash" or "sweep" enemies. "Smash" deals 90% ATK damage to all enemies in a targeted path, whereas "sweep" deals 110% ATK damage to all enemies.
本技能仅在塔莉莎处于“暴怒”状态时才能释放。对距离自身最远的一名敌人施加“死潮印记”，使其受愈降低70点，持续12秒。5秒后，塔莉莎会将携带“死潮印记”的敌人吸至战场前方中央的位置，并对其造成250% ATK伤害和3秒的眩晕效果。

Activates only when Thalassa is in Rampage state. Marks the farthest enemy with "Dead Tide Mark," reducing their Vitality by 70 for 12s. After 5s, Thalassa will pull the marked enemy to the center of the battlefield, dealing 250% ATK damage and stunning them for 3s.
一条生活在沙漠里的大沙虫，能在沙子里快速游走攻击。
A large sandworm that lives in the desert, capable of swiftly moving through the sand to attack.
萨纳斯潘特潜入沙中，在流沙地上制造出漩涡，并将分散的全场敌人聚集在战场中心，漩涡持续5秒。漩涡存在时，每秒对所有敌人造成30% ATK伤害，5秒后萨纳斯潘特选择一个敌方最密集区域冲出，在1格范围内对敌人造成150% ATK伤害并击飞0.8秒，随后回到初始位置。

Burrows beneath the sands to create a quicksand whirlpool that pulls all enemies to the center of the battlefield. The whirlpool lasts for 5s, dealing 30% ATK damage to all enemies every second. After 5s, Setsahara emerges from the area with the most enemies, dealing 150% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tiles and knocking them into the air for 0.8s before returning to its original position.
萨纳斯潘特用身体朝敌人最密集的区域砸下，造成150% ATK伤害并将区域内的敌人击倒3秒，位于萨纳斯潘特头部区域的敌人额外受到20% ATK伤害。
Targets the area with the most enemies and slams down, dealing 150% ATK damage to enemies within and knocking them down for 3s. Enemies struck by Setsahara's head take 20% ATK more damage.
萨纳斯潘特抬头吼叫，制造一个覆盖全场的震荡波，对敌人造成造成120% ATK伤害。
Creates a shockwave that deals 120% ATK damage to all enemies.
萨纳斯潘特生活在流沙地形中，处于该地形内的所有角色移动速度降低30%，只有常年在沙漠地带行走的角色可无视此效果。
Passive. The whole battlefield is quicksand. The movement speed of all units are reduced by 30%, except for units who live near and know how to traverse through the quicksand terrain.
一只生活在魔法之地的甲虫，能够在战场制作魔法迷雾，并使用迷幻魔法保护自己免受攻击。
A mysterious beetle dwelling in a magical land, capable of conjuring magical mists and protecting itself with illusions.
飞到半空并处于无敌状态，向每名敌人投掷一枚魔法球，对该敌人及其周边1格范围造成80% ATK点伤害。
Flies into the sky, becoming invincible while hurling a magic projectile at each enemy, dealing 80% ATK damage to the target and adjacent targets.
战斗开始的第10/30/50/70秒。往背部和翅膀鳞片注入特殊魔法，使得自身获得100点闪避，持续15秒。
Casts a spell that enhances the scales on the wings and back at 10/30/50/70s into a battle, increasing dodge chance by 100 for 15s.
前腿插入地下，制造3格宽的地刺，对命中的敌人造成60% ATK伤害。若该伤害导致了目标血量减少，则该目标还会被击飞并眩晕2秒。
Summons 3-tile-wide spike that extends forward, dealing 60% ATK damage to enemies hit. If enemies lose HP from this damage, they will also be knocked into the air and stunned for 2s.
战斗开始时，在战场内散布魔幻迷雾，直至战斗结束。在魔幻迷雾中的所有角色变得更加疯狂痴迷于法术，获得60点急速，每秒回复50点能量，造成的魔法伤害提升100%。

Spreads an enchanted mist across the battlefield, fueling the magic obsession of those within. Increases the Haste of allies and enemies within the mist by 60 and their magic damage by 100%. Allies and enemies also recover 50 Energy per second while in the mist.
生活在某河域的鱼王，能够使战场覆盖河流，擅长用人鱼灯魅惑敌方。
A fish king that can cover the battlefield with flowing water and excels at charming foes with mermaid lanterns.
战斗开始第35、65秒时释放，潜入水中持续7秒，美人鱼灯在这期间持续诱惑所有非召唤物敌人向自身移动，随后从水中跃出，击飞所有处于水域内的敌人造成500% ATK伤害。美人鱼灯进行诱惑时玩家可以通过快速点击英雄头像来解除诱惑，解除诱惑的英雄获得生命值40%的护盾持续8秒，护盾持续期间英雄处于霸体状态。

Dives into the water for 7s at 35 and 65 seconds into a battle. Damedangler remains submerged during this time, drawing all non-summoned enemies toward its glowing lure. It then leaps out of the water, knocking all enemies in range into the air and dealing 500% ATK damage. If a hero is charmed by Damedangler's lure, quickly tapping their avatar will remove the charm. Removing the charm grants the hero a shield equal to 40% of HP for 8s, during which the Hero is unaffected.
张嘴撕咬面前所有敌人造成150% ATK伤害，随后甩尾再次对周围敌人造成150% ATK伤害。若周围没有敌人，则对最靠前的敌人造成250% ATK魔法伤害并吸引其向自身移动直至相邻。

Bites all enemies in front, dealing 150% ATK damage then swing the tail to deal 150% ATK damage to surrounding enemies. If there are no enemies nearby, deals 250% ATK magic damage to the frontmost enemy and lure them closer.
每隔15秒将水域向外扩张1格，击飞水域内所有敌方并造成200% ATK伤害，至多扩张4次。处于水域内的敌人会受到鱼群撕咬，每秒受到20% ATK魔法伤害并降低40点急速。

Expands the attack range by 1 tile every 15s and knocks all enemies in range into the air, dealing 200% ATK damage. The attack range can be expanded up to 4 times. Enemies within range are continuously harassed by a swarm of fish, taking 20% ATK magic damage per second and losing 40 Haste.
被恶魔力量支配的傀儡，能够夺取敌人身上的增益能力并将其用于强化自己。
A puppet controlled by a dark presence, capable of stealing enemy buffs to empower himself.
战斗开始第10、30、50、70秒各释放一次，吸收所有敌人的灵魂能量，造成100% ATK伤害，使所有敌人的属性恢复到战斗开始时且无法增加持续15秒。随后释放能量再次对所有敌人造成200% ATK伤害并使其急速降低20点持续5秒，吸收能量时每有一名敌人有属性值高于战斗开始时则永久提高额外爆炸次数，至多5次，每次额外爆炸对所有敌人额外造成1次80% ATK伤害。

At 10, 30, 50, and 70s into a battle, casts this skill to absorb the power of all enemies, dealing 100% ATK damage to each enemy and resetting their stats to their starting value for 15s, during which their stats cannot increase.
Unleashes the absorbed power in a massive explosion, dealing 200% ATK damage to all enemies and reducing their Haste by 20 for 5s. For each enemy whose stats at the moments of absorption are higher than their starting value, permanently triggers 1 additional explosion, up to 5 explosions. Additional explosions deal 80% ATK damage to each enemy.
用冰魔力量为剑附魔，使后续3次普通攻击能够对前方4格矩形范围内的所有敌人造成140% ATK额外伤害。
Enchants his sword with frost magic, causing the next 3 normal attacks to deal extra 140% ATK damage to all enemies within a 4-tile rectangular area in front.
宣泄冰魔的力量，击飞自身周围2格范围内的敌人并造成160% ATK伤害。
Unleashes the strength of the frost demon, knocking enemies within 2 tiles into the air while dealing 160% ATK damage.
仅周围没有敌人时可以释放，立刻冲向最近的敌人，定身目标2秒并对其造成180% ATK伤害。
Charges at the nearest enemy, dealing 180% ATK damage while immobilizing them for 2s. This skill can only be used when no enemies are nearby.
远古时代的地狱门徒，擅长使用火焰与镰刀造成大量范围伤害。
A disciple of ancient, infernal powers. With mastery over fire and the scythe, he deals massive AoE damage.
终极技能每隔20秒会主动释放。主动释放时，连续召唤地狱火砸向敌方全体角色造成多次100% ATK伤害，随后幽灵船现身向距离最远的角色冲刺，最终对目标周围2格范围内的敌人造成100% ATK伤害，并留下鬼火，鬼火持续15秒，处于鬼火上的敌方角色无法回复能量。

Ultimate is cast every 20s. Active. Continuously summons hellfire to strike all enemies multiple times, each time dealing 100% ATK damage. A phantom ship then appears and charges at the farthest enemy, dealing 100% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles of its target and leaving ghostfire in the area for 15s. Ghostfire prevents affected enemies from regenerating Energy.
召唤虚影附身在累计造成伤害最高的敌人身上，持续12秒，每秒受到30% ATK的真实伤害，附身期间虚影每隔3秒现身并对周围1格范围内的敌人造成180% ATK伤害。

Summons a phantom that possesses the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt for 12s, dealing 30% ATK true damage per second. Every 3s, the phantom manifests, striking enemies within 1 tile of the possessed target for 180% ATK damage.
挥动武器竖直向前挥砍，召唤三道剑气对前方扇形范围内的敌人造成320% ATK伤害。
Swings weapons forward to strike down enemies, creating 3 shockwaves that deal 320% ATK damage to enemies within the radius of an arc in front.
一名散发着瘴气的巨型爬行生物，可以进行多次分裂。
A towering reptilian terror emitting toxic gas, capable of splitting multiple times.
持续抖动身体，并源源不断地从身体中弹出共计8枚泥炸弹，每一枚泥炸弹将会会对一名随机目标及其周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成110% ATK伤害。
Shakes its body, launching a total of 8 mud bombs. Each mud bomb deals 110% ATK damage to a random target and all adjacent enemies.
在场中喷射出瘴气，每秒对场上所有敌人造成60% ATK伤害。瘴气最多持续5秒。
Spews a noxious gas across the battlefield, dealing 60% ATK damage per second to all enemies. The gas lasts up to 5s.

每当自身在完整形态下累计失去相当于自身初始攻击力20000%的生命值时，腐臭瘴泥便会分裂成3只大型腐臭泥。当大型腐臭泥被击败时，每只将会分裂成2只中型腐臭泥；当中型腐臭泥被击败时，每只将会分裂成2只小型腐臭泥。
分裂产生的腐臭泥总共拥有相当于腐臭瘴泥初始攻击力15000%的生命值，且其受到的伤害会转移给腐臭瘴泥。当分裂产生的腐臭泥全部被击败后，将会重新融合成为腐臭瘴泥，但会使其进入持续8秒的虚弱状态，在此期间腐臭瘴泥受到的伤害增加20%。
每次融合完成之后，下一次触发分裂所需的生命值、分裂产生的腐臭泥的总生命值均会永久提高150%。

Splits into 3 large plaguerots whenever the Plague Creeper loses HP equal to 20000% of its initial ATK. When large plaguerots are defeated, each one will split into 2 medium plaguerots. When these medium plaguerots are defeated, each will further split into 2 small plaguerots.
The total HP of the plaguerots resulting from splitting is equal to 15000% of the Plague Creeper's initial ATK, and they will transfer damage received back to the Plague Creeper. Once all plaguerots are defeated, they will merge back into the Plague Creeper, which will remain weakened for 8s, during which its damage taken is increased by 20%.
After each merge, the HP required to trigger the next split and the total HP of the plaguerots produced increase by 150%.

腐臭瘴泥分裂出的腐臭泥可以使用多种技能攻击敌人，但随着分裂次数增多，能使用的技能会逐渐减少：
技能一：沿固定轨迹在场上巡逻，并在沿途留下毒液痕迹；
技能二：发射两枚污泥球攻击随机敌人；
技能三：被击败时产生爆炸，并留下可以持续伤害敌人的污泥区。

Plaguerots that split from the Plague Creeper can use various skills to attack enemies, but the number of available skills decreases with each split:
Skill 1: Patrols along a fixed path, leaving behind a trail of poisonous sludge.
Skill 2: Launches two sludge balls at random targets.
Skill 3: Causes an explosion upon defeat, creating a sludge pool that continuously damages enemies.
一只被海葵附着的巨型蚌壳，能够将敌人吞入腹中。
A monstrous clam encrusted with anemones, lying in wait to swallow enemies whole.
张开蚌壳，宝珠发出强烈闪光，对全场敌人造成300% ATK伤害。
Opens clam shell, emitting a dazzling flash from the pearl inside, dealing damage equal to 300% ATK to all enemies.
甩动巨舌捆住敌人，并将其吞下，持续40秒，吞噬过程中及吞噬后，若该目标处于霸体、稳定，则不会吞下，而是将其碾碎，视作被击败。

Flicks its giant tongue to grab an enemy, then swallows them for 40s. If the enemy is unaffected or steadfast during and after the casting of this skill, they will be crushed instead of swallowed, resulting in instant defeat.
连续甩动2次巨舌，对前方3格扇形范围内的敌人造成80% ATK伤害。
Flicks its giant tongue twice, dealing 80% ATK damage to all enemies within a 3-tile arc in front.
如果没有敌方非召唤物角色与自己相邻，则张口将所有敌方吸到自身周围，造成4次100% ATK伤害并施加4秒晕眩。
Opens its mouth to draw all enemies close when there are no adjacent non-summoned enemies, dealing 100% ATK damage four times and stunning them for 4s.
蚌壳精和海葵共同形成水汽屏障，使蚌壳精受到伤害减少70%。累计受到2次原始伤害量超过施法者300%攻击比例的伤害后失去屏障，10秒后恢复。

The clam and anemones generate a water barrier together, reducing the damage taken by 70%. The barrier will disappear after taking 2 hits of base damage that each exceed 300% of the caster's ATK, and will regenerate in 10s.
用于证明公会成员勇气的必经之路。拥有庞大身躯的战士，能够攻击大范围敌人，并且可以将敌人拉至身前。
A trial of courage for all guild members. The giant Mistal Warrior specializes in dealing AoE damage to enemies and pulling them near.
挥舞双爪对面前1格扇形范围内的所有敌人造成6次伤害，前5次造成100% ATK伤害，第6次造成300% ATK伤害，随后自身提高25%攻击力，持续10秒。

Swings the claws and attacks all enemies within 1 tile of the frontal area 6 times. The first 5 attacks deal 100% ATK damage, and the last deals 300% ATK damage. After the skill takes effect, gains 25% ATK for 10s.
对一名敌人及其周围2格范围内的所有敌人造成130% ATK伤害，并使其眩晕2秒。
Deals 130% ATK damage to a target and surrounding enemies within 2 tiles, and stuns them for 2s.
将一名最远的敌人拉到自身面前，并对其造成200% ATK伤害。
Pulls 1 farthest enemy near, and deals 200% ATK damage.
来自某个巨型生物的触手，仅仅通过肢体的拍击和横扫就能给敌人带来巨大威胁。
Massive tentacles from a giant creature, each strike powerful enough to crush foes.
对场上所有敌人造成213% ATK伤害。
Deals 213% ATK damage to all enemies.
残存于古战场上的巨神兵，蕴含着不羁的灵魂，会被敌人的减益削减力量。
A Wargolem left behind on the ancient battlefield. It carries an untamed spirit but is vulnerable to debuffs.
蓄力横扫，对3格扇形范围内敌方造成450% ATK的伤害，若释放技能时巨神兵拥有的远古赐福大于或等于3枚，则伤害范围扩大至6格，伤害提升至750% ATK，并使敌人造成的伤害下降30%，持续10秒。

Charges and sweeps, dealing 450% ATK damage to enemies within a 3-tile arc. If this Wargolem has 3 or more stacks of Ancient Blessing when casting the skill, increases attack range to 6 tiles and damage dealt to 750% ATK and reduces the enemies' damage dealt by 30% for 10s.
挥舞巨剑并重重劈下，斩出3道一格宽的剑气，每道剑气对目标造成攻击力250% ATK的伤害。若释放技能时巨神兵拥有的远古赐福大于或等于3枚，则斩出剑气后将衔接一道旋风斩，对周围4格敌方造成300% ATK的伤害。

Delivers a mighty strike with a greatsword, unleashing three 1-tile-wide sword shocks, each dealing 250% ATK damage. If this Wargolem has 3 or more stacks of Ancient Blessing when using the skill, the greatsword strike is followed by a whirlwind strike that deals 300% ATK damage to enemies within 4 tiles.
战斗开始时，巨神兵会获得5枚远古赐福。每枚赐福会使巨神兵受到伤害降低5%。当自身被施加非永久属性降低效果时，一枚远古赐福会消散，每名敌人只能触发一次，来源于这名敌人的属性降低效果消失后3秒，巨神兵将重新获得远古赐福。

When a battle starts, receives 5 stacks of Ancient Blessing. Each stack reduces damage taken by 5%. When inflicted with a non-permanent debuff, loses 1 stack of Ancient Blessing but regains it 3s after the debuff expires. Each enemy can trigger this effect only once.
冰元素凝结而成的神秘几何体，会变幻形态发动攻击，能够将敌人封印在坚冰中永久击碎。
A mysterious geometric entity condensed from ice. It morphs into various shapes when launching attacks, sealing enemies in ice and shattering them.
幻光冰棱变换形态，从身后快速发射多道冰锥，对场上所有敌人造成2次60% ATK的伤害。随后蓄力并发射激光，对战场中轴线附近1格的敌人造成200% ATK的伤害。

Transforms and fires multiple icicles at all enemies, dealing 60% ATK damage per enemy for 2 times. After a brief charge-up, releases a laser beam that deals 200% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile of the central axis of battlefield.
锁定当前累计伤害量最高的一名敌人，短暂蓄力后对其施加“寒冰封印”，扣除其95%当前生命值，将其冻结并降低50点受愈。在此期间，当目标的当前生命值恢复到最大生命值的50%以上时，将会自动解除“寒冰封印”。一段时间后，幻光冰棱会释放冰霜冲击波，对全场敌人造成100% ATK的伤害，并使当前受到“寒冰封印”影响的敌人碎裂成冰块，视作被击败。该“寒冰封印”效果无视霸体与无敌状态。

Charges briefly and inflicts Frost Seal on the enemy who deals the highest cumulative damage, reducing their HP by 95%, freezing them, and reducing their Vitality by 50. Frost Seal will automatically be dispelled when the target's HP recovers to above 50% of their max HP. Mirage Frostspike will release frost waves later, dealing 100% ATK damage to all enemies and shattering enemies with Frost Seal (shattered enemies are deemed defeated). This effect ignores unaffected and invincible.
生成一圈环绕自身飞行的冰锥，对距离自身偶数格距离的敌人造成250% ATK的伤害并使其眩晕1秒。每次释放该技能，冰锥的攻击距离会在奇数格和偶数格之间切换。

Summons a vortex of icicle shards, dealing 250% ATK damage to enemies located an even number of tiles away and stunning them for 1s. After the first use, the skill targets enemies located an odd number of tiles away, then alternates between even and odd-numbered tiles with each subsequent cast.
被动的，当幻光冰棱受到任何来自敌方的属性降低效果时，免疫该效果，并将其转化为3个悬浮的能量体，最多同时存在8个能量体。主动使用时，对当前目标造成300% ATK的伤害，并将场上现有的能量体全部发射出去，每个能量体分别对1名随机敌人造成120% ATK的伤害。

Passive. When Mirage Frostspike receives any stat-nerfing debuff, nullifies the debuff and converts its power into 3 floating energy masses. Up to 8 masses can exist on the battlefield at any given time.
Active. When used actively, deals 300% ATK damage to the current target and launches all energy masses at enemies, with each mass dealing 120% ATK damage to a random enemy.
出现在春焰庆中的一只小号福袋，收集它会带来快乐的奖励。
A delightful little satchel you can gather during Emberlight Festival. Collect it for great joy and exciting rewards!
快乐的春焰庆使者是不会做出攻击人这种事的！当它被收集后，会出现下一只！（你猜猜我会出现多少次？）
The cheerful Emberlight Festival emissaries are always a joy to be around! Take one, and another will appear! (Wonder how many times they'll do this?)
出现在春焰庆中的一只大号福袋，收集它会带来快乐的奖励。
An enormous lucky satchel you can gather during Emberlight Festival. Collect it for even greater joy and exciting rewards!
快乐的春焰庆使者是不会做出攻击人这种事的！当它被收集后，会出现下一只！（你猜猜我会出现多少次？）
The cheerful Emberlight Festival emissaries are always a joy to be around! Take one, and another will appear! (Wonder how many times they'll do this?)
被收集后，会给全场回复200点能量和10%攻击力，最高可叠加10层。
Grants 200 Energy and 10% ATK to all heroes present when collected, up to 10 stacks.
肉体已经畸变的绿裔女王，战斗中会夺取敌人的生命力来强化自身。
A mutated Wilder queen. In battle, she steals life force from enemies to make herself stronger.
扑向战场中心并击退周围敌人，随后开始施法持续8秒，期间每秒对所有敌人造成2.5%初始生命上限的伤害，并降低目标等量的生命上限。施法结束时，若自身处于至少3种来自不同英雄的属性降低效果则恢复敌人被此次施法降低的生命上限的80%，自身流失等量的生命值并陷入3秒的晕眩状态，否则将此次技能扣除所有敌人生命上限的1000%转化为自身的永久护盾，并永久提升20点急速。本技能结束后驱散自身所有负面状态。

Leaps to the center of the battlefield, knocking back nearby enemies. Then channels a spell for 8s, dealing damage each second equal to 2.5% of each enemy's initial max HP while reducing their max HP by the same amount. At the end of the channeling, if afflicted by at least 3 stat debuffs from different heroes, returns 80% of the reduced max HP to the affected enemies, loses the same amount of HP, and becomes stunned for 3s. Otherwise, converts 1000% of the total reduced max HP into a permanent shield and gains 20 Haste until the end of the battle. All debuffs are dispelled when the skill ends.
使一名敌人陷入“狂躁”状态直至其被击败。处于“狂躁”状态的目标提高30点攻击速度，且每秒流失5%最大生命值。优先选择距离自身最近的不处于“狂躁”状态的敌人为目标。

Causes an enemy to enter a rampage state until they are defeated. While in rampage, the target gains 30 ATK SPD but loses 5% of their max HP every second. Prioritizes the nearest enemy not already in rampage.
挥剑横扫战场，对所有敌人造成150% ATK伤害并对处于“狂躁”状态的敌人额外造成400% ATK伤害。
Performs a sweeping slash across the battlefield, dealing 150% ATK damage to all enemies. Enemies in rampage take an extra 400% ATK damage.
甩动龙尾，击退面前2格范围内的敌人并造成120% ATK伤害。
Performs a tail whip, knocking back enemies in a 2-tile arc in front and dealing 120% ATK damage.
传说中古老的初始之龙，从未有人亲眼目睹过它的真容。
An ancient dragon from legend, known as the Primordial Dragon. No one has ever seen its true form.
战斗第25/50/75秒，巨龙腾空飞起，在场上降下火雨，每0.5秒造成100% ATK伤害。期间会有数颗陨石坠落在场上，对落点1格范围内的敌人再次造成120% ATK伤害和1秒眩晕效果。

At 25, 50, and 75 seconds into the battle, the dragon soars into the air and rains fire down on the battlefield, dealing 100% ATK damage every 0.5s. During the firestorm, meteorites crash onto the battlefield, dealing an extra 120% ATK damage to enemies on the landing tiles and their adjacent enemies, stunning them for 1s.
巨龙拍击地面，将场上所有敌人击飞0.5秒并造成230% ATK伤害，每名敌人会落到对应的格子，落地时再次受到150% ATK伤害。
The dragon slams the ground, knocking all enemies into the air for 0.5s and dealing 230% ATK damage. Upon landing on their designated tiles, each enemy takes an extra 150% ATK damage.
巨龙所在的火山场地存在熔浆，每10秒会有2个熔浆口从后往前依次喷发熔浆，对附近1格范围内敌人造成150% ATK伤害并击飞0.5秒。

The volcanic site where the dragon resides is scattered with lava vents. Every 10s, 2 vents erupt one after another (from back to front), dealing 150% ATK damage to adjacent enemies and knocking them into the air for 0.5s.
巨龙朝前方扇形区域喷吐龙息，每0.5秒对范围内的敌人造成70% ATK伤害。
Breathes fire in a frontal arc, dealing 70% ATK damage every 0.5s to enemies in range.
生长在丛林中的巨型蘑菇，擅长喷洒孢子寄生并汲取敌人的能量。
A giant jungle mushroom that spreads spores, parasitizing enemies and draining their Energy.
战斗开始时，向最靠前的4名非召唤物敌人喷射寄生孢子，命中时造成300% ATK伤害，后续当其他敌人释放终极技能后，将对其喷射寄生孢子。寄生孢子每秒汲取寄生单位125点能量，当汲取能量达到1000点时进入成熟期。成熟期的蘑菇每秒会消耗1000点能量向周围1格喷射神经毒素，能量耗尽后回到成长期继续汲取能量。

When a battle starts, sprays parasitic mushroom spores at the 4 frontmost non-summoned enemies, dealing 300% ATK damage on hit. Also launches a spore at any enemy who casts their Ultimate afterward. Each spore drains 125 Energy per second from its host. After draining 1000 Energy, the spore matures into a full mushroom, consuming 1000 Energy per second and releasing neurotoxins at adjacent enemies. When a mature mushroom runs out of Energy, it reverts to spore form and resumes draining Energy from its host.
喷射毒气弥漫全场，每秒对敌人造成150% ATK伤害，降低-20%攻击力和-20点急速，持续4秒。
Releases toxic gas that covers the entire battlefield, dealing 150% ATK damage per second to enemies. The toxin also reduces affected enemies' ATK by -20% and Haste by -20 for 4s.
在敌方脚下快速生长蘑菇，对其造成120% ATK的伤害并将其顶向空中后砸向敌方最密集区域，对落地区域1格范围内的敌人造成150% ATK的伤害，若被击飞的敌人已被孢子寄生，则寄生孢子获得500点能量。

Rapidly grows a mushroom beneath an enemy, dealing 120% ATK damage to the enemy before launching them into the air and slamming them in the area with the most enemies, dealing 150% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile of the landing tile. If the launched enemy is infected by a mushroom spore, the spore gains 500 Energy.
蘑菇王向覆盖最多敌人的方向伸出藤曼，对沿途敌人造成250% ATK伤害和2秒定身。
Extends phantom roots toward the direction that covers the most enemies, dealing 250% ATK damage to enemies in their path and immobilizing them for 2s.
生活在熔岩区域的巨大蜥蜴，会使用体内的岩浆进行战斗。
A giant lizard that lives in lava areas and fights using the lava inside its body.
战斗开始的第5/25/50秒，喷发岩浆覆盖战场一个区域，直至战斗结束。岩浆区域内敌人生命恢复效果降低90%，每0.5秒受到40% ATK伤害。敌方每累计3秒受到岩浆区域造成的生命值伤害时，叠加一层“灼热”效果，每层“灼热”使敌方造成的生命损耗下降30%，该效果至多叠加3层，持续3秒，处于岩浆区域内时，会不断刷新“灼热”效果的持续时间。

At 5, 25, 50 seconds into the battle, spews lava to cover an area of the battlefield until the battle ends. Enemies in the affected area have their healing reduced by 90% and take 40% ATK damage every 0.5s.
After accumulating 3 seconds for taking HP damage from the lava, enemies gain 1 stack of scorch, which reduces the HP loss enemies can cause by 30% per stack. This effect can stack up to 3 times and lasts for 3s. Staying within the lava area will reset the duration of Scorch.
短暂蓄力后，向四周射出熔岩碎片，对全场敌人造成140% ATK伤害。敌人每有1层“灼热”效果，额外受到40%伤害。
Charges up briefly before shooting lava shards in all directions, dealing 140% ATK damage to all enemies. Each stack of scorch on an enemy increases the damage they take from this skill by 40%.
撕咬一名敌人并将其扔到岩浆区域，造成100% ATK伤害。
Bites an enemy and throws them into the lava area, dealing 100% ATK damage.
使用尾锤连续砸地两次，每次造成120% ATK伤害并击飞敌人。
Slams the ground twice with its tail, dealing 120% ATK damage each time and knocking the affected enemies into the air.
偷取能量的灵体，会在石柱上不断跳跃并使用矿石能量帮助战斗。
An Energy-stealing spirit that leaps between stone pillars, channeling ore energy to support the fight.

被动地，晶矿蚀灵在战斗中不会正常获取能量，当其身处能量尚未耗尽的矿石，且没有处于控制状态时会每秒偷取8点矿石能转化为自身32点能量。
 战斗开始第30、60秒时会主动释放，晶矿蚀灵获得短暂霸体并提前返回中央矿石，释放出自身全部能量覆盖全场，对全体敌人造成50% ATK的伤害，同时让释放出的能量环绕战场，每释放出20点能量就使自身收到的任何生命损耗降低1%，持续25秒。

Passive. Crystal Crawler does not regenerate Energy passively during battle. While standing on an ore stone that contains Energy and not under any control effects, it drains 8 Energy per second from the ore and converts it into 32 Energy for itself.
At 30s and again at 60s into a battle, Crystal Crawler casts this skill, becoming briefly unaffected and instantly returning to the central ore stone. Then it releases all stored Energy across the battlefield, dealing 50% ATK damage to all enemies. The released Energy then begins circling the battlefield. For every 20 Energy released, Crystal Crawler takes 1% less HP loss for 25s.

被动地，晶矿蚀灵在战斗中不会使用普通攻击，但会每3秒使自身脚下的矿石能量外溢，对周围2格的单位造成25% ATK的伤害；若自身在战斗中总计吸取了350点矿石能则伤害范围半径改为3格。
 晶矿蚀灵处于控制状态下时也可以使用该技能。

Passive. Crystal Crawler does not use normal attacks during battle. Instead, every 3s, causes the ore beneath it to pulse with Energy, dealing 25% ATK damage to units within 2 tiles. After Crystal Crawler has drained a total of 350 Energy, increases the pulse radius to 3 tiles.
Crystal Crawler can cast this skill while under control effects.

被动地，晶矿蚀灵拥有稳定效果，且只会站在战场中央和四周的矿石上。
 主动使用时，晶矿蚀灵会在矿石柱间跳跃，跳跃前获得短暂的霸体效果直到技能结束；每个矿石初始拥有100点能量，晶矿蚀灵会优先选择按照战场上逆时针顺序的石柱跳跃。

Passive. Crystal Crawler remains steadfast, only standing on ore stones at the center or scattered around the battlefield.
Active. Becomes unaffected and starts jumping between ore stones, with the unaffected effect lasting until the skill ends. Crystal Crawler prioritizes jumping to ores in a counterclockwise order. Each ore stone starts with 100 Energy.

每隔15秒，晶矿蚀灵会引发矿石发光，对全场敌人造成4秒致盲效果。
 晶矿蚀灵处于控制状态下时也可以使用该技能。

Every 15s, causes an ore to flash, blinding all enemies for 4s.
Crystal Crawler can cast this skill while under control effects.
精明圆滑的矮人村长，会使用各种炮台来帮助自己战斗。
A cunning dwarven chief who deploys turrets in battle.
弗林向天上丢出恩典灵露，使场上所有的友方单位获得15攻击速度加成。
Eldric launches Divine Dew into the air, increasing all allies' ATK SPD by 15.

弗林的普通攻击会指定半径一格内最虚弱的激光塔或机枪塔，对它进行三次维修，每次维修造成-100% ATK的治疗。
被动地，弗林在战斗开始时会在身前召唤两个激光塔，会使用激光普通攻击造成伤害；两根激光塔同时存在时会生成护盾保护弗林使其获得无敌效果。

Eldric's normal attacks target the weakest laser or gun turret within 1 tile, repairing it 3 times and restoring -100% ATK HP each time.
Passive. When a battle starts, Eldric summons two laser turrets in front of him that fire laser beams with normal attacks. While both laser turrets are present, they generate a shield that grants Eldric invincibility.

被动地，弗林在战斗开始时会在身前和战场两侧各召唤一个机枪塔，会发射子弹普通攻击造成伤害；同时可以释放技能“火焰弹”对目标半径一格内所有敌人造成一定伤害。
主动释放时，弗林使用龙蛋液使激光塔释放强风击退所有敌人击退5格，并在战场两侧各建造一个机枪塔。
若有敌人闯进弗林周围两格且弗林没有主动发动过此技能时，弗林会立刻主动使用该技能。

Passive. When a battle starts, Eldric summons one gun turret in front and one on each side of the battlefield. These turrets fire bullets with normal attacks. Meanwhile, Eldric can cast Flame Bomb that deals AoE damage to the target and adjacent enemies.
Active. Eldric uses dragon egg essence to unleash a gust of air from the laser turrets, knocking back all enemies by 5 tiles. He also summons a gun turret on each side of the battlefield.
If an enemy enters within 2 tiles of Eldric before he can actively cast this skill, the skill is cast immediately.
高原地区的一只巨隼，守护着一枚拥有神秘力量的蛋。
A towering falcon of the highlands, protector of an egg filled with mysterious power.
巨隼守护一枚具有神堕力量的蛋，当自身在场时蛋无法被攻击。巨隼在场战斗25秒后会逃离战场，并清除自身所有增减益效果，直至蛋被击破或15秒后，巨隼俯冲掠过战场，将所有敌人往两侧击退并击倒2格距离，造成300% ATK伤害，随后重新回到战斗。

Cinderwings guards an egg infused with corrupt power. While Cinderwings is present on the battlefield, the egg cannot be attacked. 25s into a battle, Cinderwings flees the battlefield, cleansing itself of all buffs and debuffs. When the egg is destroyed or after 15s, Cinderwings dives across the battlefield, knocking all enemies back 2 tiles to either side and knocking them down, dealing 300% ATK damage. It then re-enters the battlefield.
蛋具有神堕力量，使自身受到除普通攻击以外的生命损耗效果降低99%，并使巨隼受到除普通攻击以外的生命损耗效果降低80%。蛋初始具有巨隼攻击力300000%的生命值，生命值为零时蛋进入击破状态，使全体敌方获得80点攻击速度，持续10秒。巨隼在场时，蛋会修复自身至完整状态。

The egg's immense power reduces HP loss from non-normal attacks by 99% for itself and by 80% for Cinderwings. The egg's HP is initially set to 300000% of Cinderwings' ATK. When the egg is destroyed, all enemies gain 80 ATK SPD for 10s. While Cinderwings remains on the battlefield, the egg gradually regenerates to full HP.
巨隼发出尖锐鸣叫，每0.25秒对全场敌人造成80% ATK伤害。
Cinderwings lets out piercing cries, dealing 80% ATK damage to all enemies every 0.25s.
巨隼扇动翅膀形成2个风龙卷，对两侧3格宽路径上的敌人造成100% ATK伤害。
Cinderwings whips up 2 tornadoes, dealing 100% ATK damage to enemies in two 3-tile-wide paths, one on each side of the battlefield.
隐藏在沼泽中的恐怖怪物，会吞噬那些被诱惑而进入其体内的生物。
A terrifying creature lurking in the swamp, consuming all who are drawn into its gaping maw.
战斗第20/45/70秒时主动释放，点燃魔焰立即对所有敌人造成240% ATK伤害，并使目标提高20点“恐惑值”。释放技能后使更浓烈的魔雾永久覆盖战场，每秒使所有敌人提高1点“恐惑值”，该效果可以叠加。

20s, 45s, and 70s into a battle, ignites an arcane flame, instantly dealing 240% ATK damage to all enemies and increasing their Dread by 20. After casting, a dense fog permanently covers the field, increasing all enemies' Dread by 1 per second. This effect stacks.
幽泽噬影屋诱惑并试图吞没战场内的所有敌人。战斗开始时幽泽噬影屋使所有敌人恢复全部能量并获得100点“恐惑值”。“恐惑值”最高叠加100点，每1点“恐惑值”使该敌人造成的生命损耗降低0.8%，当敌人拥有100点“恐惑值”持续10秒后，会主动走入幽泽噬影屋体内，视作被击败。处于护盾保护下的敌人不受“恐惑值”的负面效果影响，每秒消耗相当于幽泽噬影屋初始攻击力20%的护盾量并降低4点“恐惑值”。

Gloommaw attempts to lure and devour all enemies. At the start of battle, it restores all enemies to full Energy and inflicts them with 100 Dread. Dread stacks up to 100 points. Each point of Dread reduces HP loss dealt by the enemy by 0.8%. If an enemy has 100 Dread for 10s, they are forced into Gloommaw's jaws and are instantly defeated. Shielded enemies are immune to Dread-induced debuffs, but their shields are drained by 20% of Gloommaw's initial ATK per second, and their Dread decreases by 4 per second.
被动地，幽泽噬影屋的普通攻击会额外选择所有“恐惑值”大于50点的敌人为目标。主动释放时对敌人造成160% ATK伤害并使孤立的敌人提高10点“恐惑值”。

Passive. Normal attacks also hit enemies with over 50 Dread.
Active. Deals 160% ATK damage and increases the Dread of isolated enemies by 10.
击飞面前方向3格宽度的敌人并造成120% ATK伤害。
Knocks enemies in a 3-tile-wide area in front into the air, dealing 120% ATK damage.
蛮血部落信仰的狩猎之神。
A hunting deity revered by the Maulers.
使手中的长刀获得狩猎赐福，向最靠后的2名敌人掷出长刀造成150% ATK伤害并将其拉到身前，随后拔刀对前方3格扇形范围内的敌人进行斩击造成350% ATK伤害，并使目标恐惧，持续3秒。

Blesses her blade with divine power, then throws it at the 2 rearmost enemies, dealing 150% ATK damage to them and pulling them close. She then unleashes a devastating slashing attack on enemies within a 3-tile arc in front, dealing 350% ATK damage to them and frightening them for 3s.
生活在坠星湖中的水属性魔法生物，擅长操纵周围水元素的力量攻击敌人，寻常的攻击无法对其造成伤害。
A magical creature native to Starfall Lake. Manipulates surrounding water to attack enemies. Immune to ordinary attacks.
战场第15/45/75秒时，坠星湖女士将会使战场中被水淹没8秒，技能结束后水将会消退。被淹没期间，将会有水生物从水中跃出砸向战场，对所有敌人造成2次120% ATK的伤害，并击飞1秒。

At the 15, 45, and 75 second marks of a battle, Lady Starfallen floods the battlefield for 8s. The water then recedes after the skill ends. While the battlefield is flooded, aquatic creatures periodically leap from the water. As they fall, they deal 120% ATK damage to all enemies 2 times and knock them into the air for 1s.
在所有敌人头顶汇聚水球，2秒后落下，对所有敌方单位造成3次60% ATK的伤害。
Lady Starfallen forms water orbs in the air and drops them 2s later to deal 60% ATK damage to all enemies 3 times.
被动地，坠星湖女士汇聚自然灵气聚成，她受到除法器外所有的生命损耗将会减少99%。主动使用时会使用"流水屏障"笼罩星水晶，此时星水晶将无法受到治疗效果，也无法攻击和释放技能。"流水屏障"拥有坠星湖女士初始攻击力100%的生命值，可被打破，但受到来自普通攻击的伤害降低90%。

Passive. Born of nature itself, Lady Starfallen takes 99% less HP loss from all sources except the Starcore.
Active. Lady Starfallen disrupts the Falling Starcore's flow of power, sealing it within a barrier of flowing water. While sealed, the Falling Starcore cannot attack, cast skills, or receive healing. The barrier has HP equal to 100% of Lady Starfallen's initial ATK and can be destroyed, but it takes 90% less damage from normal attacks.
被虫卵寄生并控制的大树，使用藤蔓捕获周围的敌人
A massive tree infested with poisonous eggs; it traps nearby enemies with its vines.
蚀声巨树使用藤蔓抽打在场的所有敌人，造成8次70% ATK伤害并甩出1枚有毒的虫卵。虫卵拥有蚀声巨树攻击力600%的生命值，并且最多存在8秒，虫卵存在期间蚀声巨树无法被攻击。若8秒内虫卵没有被打破，则会对周围1格内的所有敌人造成300% ATK伤害。若虫卵在持续时间内被打破，则会使蚀声巨树得到净化，削弱其部分技能，并提高所有敌人3%攻击力，持续至战斗结束，净化效果最多可叠加3次。

The Sound Thresher lashes all enemies with vines, dealing 70% ATK damage 8 times, then flings a poisonous egg onto the battlefield. The egg has HP equal to 600% of the Sound Thresher's ATK and lasts up to 8s.
While the egg remains, enemies cannot attack Sound Thresher. If the egg survives for 8s, it explodes and deals 300% ATK damage to all adjacent enemies. If the egg is destroyed before expiration, the Sound Thresher becomes purified, weakening some of its skills and increasing all enemies' ATK by 3% for the rest of the battle. This purification effect stacks up to 3 times.
蚀声巨树选择所在敌人最多的5条直线召唤藤蔓，藤蔓向前延伸并对触碰到的所有敌人造成240% ATK伤害。每当敌方击破蚀声巨树的虫卵，会使藤蔓数量减少1条。

The Sound Thresher targets the 5 most crowded lines of enemies, stretching vines forward along these lines and dealing 240% ATK damage to all enemies hit. Whenever an enemy destroys one of its dreadseeds, the number of vines is reduced by 1.
蚀声巨树受到的感染使其产生排异反应，向前猛烈地打喷嚏，对场上所有敌人造成200% ATK伤害并且将他们击退到场地最外围。
The Sound Thresher reacts violently to the infection, unleashing a powerful sneeze forward that deals 200% ATK damage to all enemies and knocks them back to the battlefield's edges.
被动地，蚀声巨树会在敌方半场最后排的3格范围生成腐蚀藤蔓区域，当敌方在腐蚀藤蔓区域逗留超过5秒后，藤蔓会抓取并强制控制该英雄直至战斗结束。每当敌方击破蚀声巨树的虫卵，将会使腐蚀藤蔓退散一格，并且归还当前位置上被吊起的敌方。当所有敌方英雄均被蚀声巨树抓取时，战斗将会强制结束。

Passive. The Sound Thresher creates an area of corrosive vines that covers 3 tiles in the backline of the enemy's half of the battlefield. If an enemy remains within the area for more than 5s, the vines grab and restrain them until the battle ends. Whenever an enemy destroys one of the Sound Thresher's dreadseeds, the corrosive vines retreat by 1 tile and release any enemy currently suspended over that tile. If all enemy heroes are grabbed by the Sound Thresher, the battle ends immediately.
恐怖诡异的稻草人，会与乌鸦共同狩猎敌人。
A sinister scarecrow that hunts enemies together with its crows.
战斗第30/60秒时主动释放，夜幕降临并召唤大量鸦群对所有敌人造成240% ATK伤害，随后闪现至敌方累计释放终极技能次数最少的英雄身前（次数相同时优先选择布阵时更靠后的敌人），将其永久转变为稻草人，该状态视为被击败。

At 30 and 60 seconds into a battle, summons nightfall and a large flock of crows that deal 240% ATK damage to all enemies. Then teleports in front of the enemy hero who has cast the fewest Ultimates and permanently transforms them into a scarecrow, instantly defeating them. If multiple enemy heroes have cast the same number of Ultimates, the one positioned farther back is targeted.
战斗开始时苏醒，召唤乌鸦自动纠缠所有敌人，乌鸦每秒对敌人造成40% ATK伤害，被乌鸦纠缠的敌人造成的生命损耗降低90%，鸦群会在对应敌人释放终极技能时被暂时驱赶，直到其释放结束3秒后继续纠缠该敌人。

When a battle starts, wakes up and summons crows that harass all enemies, dealing 40% ATK damage each second. Enemies harassed by the crows inflict 90% less HP loss. If a harassed enemy casts an Ultimate, the crows are driven away and will not return until 3s after the Ultimate ends.
挥舞镰刀，对面前2格扇形范围的敌人造成2次120% ATK伤害，随后旋转挥矛对周围3格范围的敌人造成140% ATK伤害。
Swings the scythe to deal 120% ATK damage twice to enemies within a 2-tile forward arc. Then spins and sweeps the spear, dealing 140% ATK damage to nearby enemies within 3 tiles.
朝最靠后的敌人投掷镰刀，造成2次120% ATK伤害，随后朝其掷出长矛造成140% ATK伤害。
Hurls a scythe at the rearmost enemy, dealing 120% ATK damage twice. Then hurls a spear at the same target, dealing 140% ATK damage.
神秘的远古机关，拥有土元素之力。
A mysterious ancient contraption imbued with the power of earth elementals.
引发地鸣生成流沙漩涡，持续5秒，流沙漩涡将持续吸附所有敌人，并每秒造成80% ATK伤害。
Unleashes a roaring quake that forms a quicksand vortex lasting 5s. The vortex pulls in all enemies and deals 80% ATK damage per second.
被动地，战斗开始时封印之楔处于防御状态，受到伤害减60%，当“机关区域”存在近战英雄时，封印之楔将解除防护，被封印的近战/远程英雄每秒受到40% ATK/80% ATK伤害。

Passive. When a battle starts, the sealing wedge enters defense mode, reducing damage taken by 60%. If there are melee heroes in the effective area, the sealing wedge exits defense mode. Sealed melee/ranged heroes then take 40% ATK/80% ATK damage per second.
封印之楔引发能量波，对全场敌人造成100% ATK伤害和1.5秒眩晕，若此时“机关区域”没有敌方英雄，则会将敌方英雄传送至该区域并将其封印（优先传送近战敌人）

The sealing wedge unleashes an energy pulse, dealing 100% ATK damage and stunning all enemies for 1.5s. If there are no enemy heroes in the effective area, the wedge teleports enemy heroes into the area and seals them (prioritizes melee heroes).
堕落后的丰饶之神，擅长操纵腐败之力弱化敌人。
The fallen God of Harvest, who commands the power of corruption to weaken his foes.
召唤蝗灾席卷战场，持续8秒。蝗灾每秒对全场敌人造成50% ATK伤害。
Summons locusts to swarm the battlefield for 8s, dealing 50% ATK damage per second to all enemies.

战斗开始时，召唤衰败之雾笼罩至整个战场，使敌人造成的所有生命损耗效果降低1%。在随后第15/30/45秒，丰饶神还会进一步施展衰败之力，对战局产生永久性的改变：
第15秒：强化衰败之雾的力量，使所有敌人造成的生命损耗效果降低15%，受愈降低20点。
第30秒：进一步强化衰败之雾的力量，使所有敌人造成的生命损耗效果降低30%、降低95点受愈，并且无法使用终极技能。
第45秒：衰败之雾彻底侵袭了整片战场，除原有效果外，还会额外使场上所有敌人每秒流失15%最大生命值，并使其攻击速度与和急速降低75点，直至所有敌人被击败。

When a battle starts, Sarethiel summons a mist of decay over the entire battlefield, reducing all enemy-inflicted HP loss effects by 1%. 15/30/45s into the battle, he further unleashes the power of decay, permanently changing the dynamics of the battle:
At 15s: Enhances the mist, reducing all enemy-inflicted HP loss effects by 15% and causing enemies to lose 20 Vitality.
At 30s: Enhances the mist further, reducing all enemy-inflicted HP loss effects by 30%, causing enemies to lose 95 Vitality, and disabling their Ultimates.
At 45s: The mist consumes the entire battlefield. In addition to its existing effects, all enemies lose 15% of max HP per second, and their ATK SPD and Haste are reduced by 75. This effect lasts until all enemies are defeated.
跳向敌方最密集区域，随后跳回原位。两次跳跃会分别对落点周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成180% ATK的伤害和1秒击飞。
Leaps into the area with the most enemies, then leaps back. Each leap deals 180% ATK damage to adjacent enemies and knocks them into the air for 1s.
在最靠前的3名敌人脚下召唤腐朽之棘，对其造成250% ATK伤害，并使其护甲与魔抗降低15%，持续5秒。
Summons rotting spikes under the 3 frontmost enemies, dealing 250% ATK damage and reducing their Phys & Magic DEF by 15% for 5s.
丰饶神的坐骑，巨大的黄金野猪，会在战场上横冲直撞攻击敌人。
The God of Harvest's mighty mount, a colossal golden beast that charges fearlessly across the battlefield.
发狂，不受控制地横冲直撞8秒，将沿途所有敌人击飞并造成150% ATK伤害。
In a fit of berserk rage, charges forward for 8s, knocking all enemies in its path into the air and dealing 150% ATK damage.
在地上来回打滚翻腾，对周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成3次180% ATK伤害。
Rolls and thrashes on the ground, dealing 180% ATK damage 3 times to all adjacent enemies.
神秘的远古机关，拥有风元素之力。
A mysterious ancient contraption imbued with the power of wind elementals.
在战场边缘召唤4道飓风席卷全场，飓风每0.5秒将对周围1格的敌人造成20% ATK伤害，并将其击退1格。
Summons 4 hurricanes that sweep across the battlefield. Each hurricane deals 20% ATK damage every 0.5s to adjacent enemies, knocking them back 1 tile.
被动地，战斗开始时封印之楔处于防御状态，受到伤害减60%，当“机关区域”存在远程英雄时，封印之楔将解除防护，被封印的近战/远程英雄每秒受到80% ATK/40% ATK伤害。

Passive. When a battle starts, the sealing wedge enters defense mode, reducing damage taken by 60%. If there are ranged heroes in the effective area, the sealing wedge exits defense mode. Sealed melee/ranged heroes then take 80% ATK/40% ATK damage per second.
封印之楔引发能量波，对全场敌人造成100% ATK伤害和1.5秒眩晕，若此时“机关区域”没有敌方英雄，则会将敌方英雄传送至该区域并将其封印（优先传送远程敌人）

The sealing wedge unleashes an energy pulse, dealing 100% ATK damage and stunning all enemies for 1.5s. If there are no enemy heroes in the effective area, the wedge teleports enemy heroes into the area and seals them (prioritizes ranged heroes).
喜欢残酷和血腥的堕落狩猎之神，擅长施加裂伤和召唤猛兽。
The fallen Hunting Goddess, cruel and bloodthirsty, strikes with savage attacks and summons feral beasts.
使手中的长刀获得狩猎赐福，向布阵时最靠后的4名敌人掷出长刀造成50% ATK伤害并将其拉到身前，随后拔刀对前方3格扇形范围内的敌人进行斩击造成80% ATK伤害，每层“裂伤”额外造成1% ATK伤害，并使目标恐惧，持续1.5秒。

Blesses her blade with divine power, then throws it at the 4 enemies positioned in the rearmost tiles during the preparation phase, dealing 50% ATK damage to them and pulling them close. She then unleashes a devastating slashing attack on enemies within a 3-tile arc, dealing 80% ATK damage to them, plus 1% ATK bonus damage for each Rend stack the enemy has. Frightens affected targets for 1.5s.
使手中的长刀获得狩猎赐福，向布阵时最靠后的4名敌人掷出长刀造成120% ATK伤害并将其拉到身前，随后拔刀对前方3格扇形范围内的敌人进行斩击造成80% ATK伤害，每层“裂伤”额外造成1% ATK伤害，并使目标恐惧，持续1.5秒。

Blesses her blade with divine power, then throws it at the 4 enemies positioned in the rearmost tiles during the preparation phase, dealing 120% ATK damage to them and pulling them close. She then unleashes a devastating slashing attack on enemies within a 3-tile arc, dealing 80% ATK damage to them, plus 1% ATK bonus damage for each Rend stack the enemy has. Frightens affected targets for 1.5s.
激发长刀的力量横扫全场，对所有敌人造成80% ATK伤害，同时施加总计30层可分摊的“裂伤”。被动地，每层“裂伤”对目标造成0.5%生命值的生命削减。

Channels her blade's full power in a sweeping strike across the battlefield, dealing 80% ATK damage to all enemies and inflicting 30 stacks of Rend spread between the enemies.
Passive. Each Rend stack inflicts max HP reduction equal to 0.5% of the target's HP.
激发长刀的力量横扫全场，对所有敌人造成80% ATK伤害，同时施加总计50层可分摊的“裂伤”。被动地，每层“裂伤”对目标造成0.5%生命值的生命削减。

Channels her blade's full power in a sweeping strike across the battlefield, dealing 80% ATK damage to all enemies and inflicting 50 stacks of Rend spread between the enemies.
Passive. Each Rend stack inflicts max HP reduction equal to 0.5% of the target's HP.
对距离最近的敌人发起斩击造成130% ATK伤害，如果目标“裂伤”层数小于100，则施加3层“裂伤”，若“裂伤”层数大于等于100，则将其缠绕后击败。

Performs a slashing attack against the nearest enemy, dealing 130% ATK damage. If the target has fewer than 100 Rend stacks, inflicts 3 more stacks. If they have 100 or more Rend stacks, entangles and defeats them.
狩猎神在自身周围依次召唤7只猛兽之影，沿直线向前冲撞，对沿途的敌人造成150% ATK伤害和2秒眩晕。
The Hunting Goddess summons 7 spectral beasts around herself. They charge forward in a straight line, dealing 150% ATK damage to all enemies in their path and stunning them for 2s.
受到贪婪控制的领主弗朗茨，擅长操纵敌人的欲望。
Lord Franz corrupted by greed, skilled at manipulating the desires of enemies.
点燃所有人心中的欲望，使所有敌方单位立刻受到一次170% ATK的伤害，并在战场中心生成一朵小型的欲望之花，欲望之花5秒后绽放，对2格范围的敌方造成240% ATK的伤害。

Ignites desire in all hearts, immediately dealing 170% ATK damage to all enemies. At the same time, summons a flower of desire at the center of the battlefield. 5s later, the flower blooms, dealing 240% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles.
贪婪控制弗朗茨为3名敌方单位签订契约。签订契约的敌人将会降低20%的攻击力，持续10秒。
Driven by greed, Franz signs a contract with 3 enemies. Contract-bound enemies have their ATK reduced by 20% for 10s.
受贪婪强硬的能量影响，每当弗朗茨使用技能后，都会使自身立刻受到一次反噬，受到60% ATK的伤害。
Affected by the oppressive energy of greed, Franz triggers backlash whenever he casts a skill, taking 60% ATK damage.
贪婪操纵弗朗茨手上的剑，击向场上未被"契约"且最虚弱的的目标，造成250% ATK的伤害。
Driven by greed, Franz uses his sword to strike the weakest enemy without a contract, dealing 250% ATK damage.
黑金商会的高层之一，主张“合作共赢”。
An Adamant Syndicate leader who believes in "win-win partnerships".
点燃人们心中的欲望，唤出持续10秒的欲望之花，欲望之花存在时，使所有敌人提高30点受愈并且每秒损失15%当前生命值，欲望之花在10秒后绽放，对所有敌人造成200% ATK的伤害并额外造成目标30%已损失生命的真实伤害。

Ignites desire in all hearts, summoning a flower of desire that lasts 10s. While active, the flower increases all enemies' Vitality by 30 and causes them to lose 15% HP every second. 10s later, the flower blooms, dealing 200% ATK damage to all enemies, plus extra true damage equal to 30% of enemies' lost HP.
与最靠后的3名敌人签订契约，使其获得20点能量，但会在接下来的10秒内降低20%攻击力。
Signs a contract with the 3 rearmost enemies, granting them 20 Energy but reducing their ATK by 20% for the next 10s.
贪婪受到契约之力的守护，免疫持续伤害。
Becomes immune to continuous damage through the power of contracts.
奥瑞利安会对场上其他角色进行资质评估，生命比例低于30%持续超过3秒的其他角色会被奥瑞利安直接抹除。
Evaluates all other units on the battlefield and instantly defeats any units whose HP ratio remains below 30% for more than 3s.
魔化状态的格墨文，操控月之魔法，拥有令人畏惧的力量。
The corrupted Gervan, wielding the chilling power of moon magic.

格墨文每20秒在敌方最密集区域生成一个月影，“残月”状态下月影持续2秒并且会对2格范围内的敌人每0.25秒造成30% ATK伤害。
“满月”状态下，格墨文会在月影持续时间结束后额外召唤一道3格宽的摆动镰刀，对路径上的敌人造成120% ATK的伤害。

Every 20s, Gervan creates a moon shadow in the area with the most enemies. In Crescent state, the moon shadow lasts for 2s, dealing 30% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles every 0.25s.
In Full Moon state, when the moon shadow expires, Gervan summons a 3-tile-wide swinging scythe, dealing 120% ATK damage to enemies in its path.

“残月”状态下格墨文对最靠后的3名单位降下月光造成60% ATK的伤害。
“满月”状态下，格墨文降下的月光会对目标及其周围1格造成100% ATK的伤害。

In Crescent state, Gervan calls down moonlight on the 3 rearmost enemies, dealing 60% ATK damage.
In Full Moon state, the moonlight deals 100% ATK damage to the target and adjacent enemies.
格墨文会逐渐从月光中汲取力量，在战斗开始时处于“残月”状态，45秒后进入“满月”状态。格墨文受到月光的庇护，除魔法伤害以外的生命损耗降低10%，“满月”状态下生命损耗降低额外提升至20%。“满月”状态下普通攻击发射的刀光具有贯穿效果，会对路径上的敌人造成相同的伤害。

Gervan gradually draws power from moonlight. He starts the battle in Crescent state and enters Full Moon state after 45s. Protected by moonlight, Gervan takes 10% less HP loss from all sources except magic damage. In Full Moon state, this HP loss reduction increases to 20%. In Full Moon state, the blade light emitted by Gervan's normal attacks pierces through enemies, dealing the same damage to all targets in the path.
“残月”状态下，格墨文会将脚下的月环飞出，对场上所有单位造成150% ATK的伤害。“满月”状态下，伤害增加至160%。

In Crescent state, Gervan launches the lunar rings beneath his feet, dealing 150% ATK damage to all units on the battlefield. 
In Full Moon state, the damage increases to 160%.
下水道里的怪物，不具备视力但对声音极其敏感。
A monster lurking in the sewers. Blind, but extremely sensitive to sound.
向战场喷吐毒液，使所有地图块覆盖一层剧毒，持续至有敌人进入地块，并使该敌人中毒持续8秒，持续期间该敌人每秒受到毒沼盲蛙30%攻击力的伤害，并且造成的生命损耗降低10%，中毒的敌人如果再次接触剧毒则毒性过载，造成的生命损耗额外降低80%并且急速降低100点，同时使中毒时间延长10秒，该时间可以叠加。

Spits venom across the battlefield, coating every tile in poison until an enemy steps onto it. That enemy becomes poisoned for 8s. While poisoned, they take damage equal to 30% of Marshtoad's ATK every second, and the HP loss they inflict is reduced by 10%. If a poisoned enemy is poisoned again, they suffer Poison Overload, further reducing the HP loss they inflict by 80%, reducing their Haste by 100, and extending the duration of poison by 10s. This extension can stack.

被动地，毒沼盲蛙不具备视力但听觉灵敏。战斗开始时，毒沼盲蛙对所有敌人不具备辨识度。当有敌人发生位置变化时，该过程持续超过1秒或距离变化超过2格，毒沼盲蛙会成功识别该敌人，对成功识别的敌人造成伤害提高40%，识别过敌人时毒沼盲蛙受到的生命损耗永久降低40%。
战斗状态下，毒沼盲蛙普通攻击会攻击识别到的距离最近的敌人，若未辨识任何敌人则随机攻击战场随机位置。主动释放该技能时对识别到的最近的敌人发射8枚毒弹，每次毒弹造成50% ATK伤害，若未辨识任何目标，则将8枚毒弹分散发射至战场随机位置。

Passive. Marshtoad cannot see, but has extremely sharp hearing. All enemies are unidentified at the start of battle. If an enemy keeps moving for more than 1s or moves more than 2 tiles, Marshtoad identifies that enemy and deals 40% more damage to them. Once Marshtoad has identified an enemy, the HP loss it takes is permanently reduced by 40%.
Marshtoad's normal attacks target the nearest identified enemy. If it has not identified any enemies, it attacks a random tile instead. When this skill is used actively, Marshtoad fires 8 poisonous projectiles at the nearest identified enemy, with each projectile dealing 50% ATK damage. If no target has been identified, the 8 projectiles are scattered across random tiles on the battlefield.
使用舌头包裹岩石，向识别到的距离最近的敌人投掷巨石，对目标及其周围1格范围内的敌人造成150% ATK并使被瞄准的目标倒地2秒，若未辨识任何目标，则随机投掷到战场随机位置且不会使命中的敌人倒地。

Wraps a rock with its tongue and throws it at the nearest identified enemy, dealing 150% ATK damage to the target and adjacent enemies, and knocking down the main target for 2s. If no target has been identified, throws the rock at a random tile instead; enemies hit will not be knocked down.
来回旋转身体，用爪子和尾巴横扫周围敌人2次，每次对自身周围2格范围内的敌人造成120% ATK伤害，并击退范围内的目标1格。该技能仅在范围内存在敌人时释放。

Spins around, sweeping nearby enemies twice with its claws and tail. Each sweep deals 120% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles and knocks them back 1 tile. This skill is only cast when there are enemies within range.
一名古老的法师，操纵强大的镜面魔法迷惑并攻击敌人。
An ancient Mage who confounds and strikes enemies with powerful mirror magic.
在战场边缘召唤数面镜子，随后发射激光再镜子间快速弹射，对全场敌人快速造成6次30% ATK的伤害，随后镜子破碎并伴随耀眼的强光，对全场敌人再次造成120% ATK的伤害并施加持续3秒的致盲效果。

Summons several mirrors along the edges of the battlefield, then fires a laser that rapidly bounces between them, dealing 30% ATK damage 6 times to all enemies. After that, the mirrors shatter, emitting a dazzling light that deals an extra 120% ATK damage to all enemies and blinds them for 3s.
在敌人人数较多的半场边缘召唤镜中人残影，对处于这半场的所有敌人造成4次50% ATK的伤害，并降低其40%护甲与魔抗持续6秒。
Summons mirror specters along the edges of the side of the battlefield with more enemies, dealing 50% ATK damage 4 times to all enemies on that side and reducing their Phys & Magic DEF by 40% for 6s.

在身前生成一面镜子护盾，当护盾存在时，魔灵镜影会免疫原始生命损耗量小于施法者初始攻击力比例300%的生命损耗效果，护盾存在期间魔灵镜影每次受到伤害的原始生命损耗量与施法者初始攻击力的比例累计超过4500%时护盾会被击碎。
护盾破碎后会进入5秒的充能状态，充能时间结束后再次获得该护盾。充能过程中，魔灵镜影每次受到原始生命损耗量大于等于施法者初始攻击力比例300%的生命损耗效果时，会累计此攻击比例，每累计4500%的比例，会使充能时间延长5秒。

Creates a mirror shield in front. While the shield is active, Mirror Wraith is immune to any HP loss effects whose base loss value is below 300% of the caster's initial ATK. The shield breaks when the cumulative base HP loss exceeds 4500% of the caster's initial ATK.
After the shield breaks, it begins charging for 5s before it is restored. While charging, any base HP loss taken that equals or exceeds 300% of the caster's initial ATK is accumulated. Every time this accumulated total reaches 4500% of the caster's initial ATK, the charging time is extended by 5s.
对两名输出最高的敌人施加镜面厄运，持续7秒。被厄运所诅咒的角色每次造成伤害都会受到一次20% ATK镜面反击伤害。
Applies Mirrored Curse to the 2 enemies with the highest damage dealt for 7s. Whenever a cursed enemy deals damage, they take 20% ATK counterattack damage from the mirror.
美丽又充满危险的剑士，使用剑术和寄生的能力缓慢蚕食敌人。
A beautiful yet deadly swordswoman, wielding blades and parasites to whittle down enemies.
花冢骨殇在战场中央绽花朵风暴，对所有敌方单位造成240% ATK伤害。每次释放后，会使花蛊的“寄生值”增长速度提高20%。
Unleashes a storm of flowers in the center of the battlefield, dealing 240% ATK damage to all enemies. Each cast accelerates Bloomrot's Parasite Level increase by 20%.

战斗开始时，花冢骨殇对所有敌方单位造成120% ATK伤害，并生成范围全场的花蛊领域，处于花蛊领域的敌方单位会被花蛊寄生，不可被驱散。花蛊拥有500% ATK“寄生值”上限，初始拥有30%的“寄生值”，并且每秒增长5%。花蛊存在期间，目标的攻击力会根据当前“寄生值”百分比降低，最多降低80%。当目标受到友方来源的生命损失时，花蛊会扣除等同于原始伤害量的“寄生值”，且溢出部分会保留，并使目标在接下来的6秒内不会因花蛊降低攻击力。“寄生值”首次达到满值时，永久扣除目标60%最大生命值上限和200点急速。花冢骨殇受到“寄生值”为0的敌方单位的伤害提高15%。

When a battle starts, deals 120% ATK damage to all enemies and creates a Bloomrot field covering the entire battlefield. Enemies within the field are afflicted with Bloomrot, which cannot be dispelled.
Each Bloomrot starts at 30% Parasite Level, which increases by 5% every second, up to a maximum of 500% ATK. The host's ATK is reduced by a percentage scaling with the Bloomrot's current Parasite Level (up to a 80% reduction). The first time a Bloomrot reaches maximum Parasite Level, its host permanently loses 60% max HP and 200 Haste.
When a host loses HP from an allied source, their Bloomrot's Parasite Level is reduced by an amount equal to the base HP lost (excess reduction is carried over). The Bloomrot will then stop reducing the host's ATK for 6s.
Gravebloom Maiden takes 15% more damage from enemies with 0 Parasite Level.
花冢骨殇对“寄生值”最高的敌方英雄造成200% ATK伤害，并将其击倒，眩晕5秒。
Deals 200% ATK damage to the enemy hero with the highest Parasite Level, knocking them down and stunning them for 5s.
花冢骨殇将双剑交叉于身前，对前方5格矩形范围打出十字剑芒，对范围内所有敌人造成160% ATK伤害。
Crosses the swords in front and unleashes a cross-shaped slash, dealing 160% ATK damage to all enemies within a 5-tile rectangular area in front.
偏执又疯狂的研究者，在他身边没有人能逃脱被改造的命运。
An obsessive, deranged researcher. No one who crosses his path escapes his twisted experiments unchanged.

在战斗开始，30秒和60秒时，禁忌炼造师会分别调配不同配方的药剂，选择不同的实验目标。若实验目标在注射药剂后被击败，禁忌炼造师会提取出药剂中的增益效果施加给自身。
1号狂暴试剂：选择初始站位最靠前的敌人作为实验目标，使其回能速率降低80%，但同时攻击速度提升300点，普通攻击造成的伤害提升100%，持续到战斗结束。
2号失能试剂：选择初始站位最靠后的敌人作为实验目标，使其攻击力降低70%，但同时急速提升250点，持续到战斗结束。
3号毁灭试剂：调配过程中药剂涌出，对周围3格内的敌人造成200% ATK伤害，并且不分敌我的使范围内所有角色所受到和造成的生命损耗提升30%，持续到战斗结束。

The Grave Alchemist prepares different potions and selects different test subjects when a battle starts and at 30s and 60s into the battle. If a test subject is defeated after being injected with a potion, the Grave Alchemist gains the potion's buffs.
Potion 1: Rampage.
Rampage: Selects the enemy who starts the battle in the frontmost position as the test subject. Reduces their Energy recovery efficiency by 80%, but increases their ATK SPD by 300 and normal attack damage by 100% for the rest of the battle.
Potion 2: Debilitation.
Debilitation: Selects the enemy who starts the battle in the rearmost position as the test subject. Reduces their ATK by 70%, but increases their Haste by 250 for the rest of the battle.
Potion 3: Annihilation.
Annihilation: The potion overflows during preparation, dealing 200% ATK damage to all enemies within 3 tiles. Additionally, it increases the HP loss all units in range inflict and take by 30% for the rest of the battle.
战斗开始时往战场内释放毒气，仅有自身2格范围内存在屏障隔绝毒气。所有敌人连续处于毒气范围5秒后会中毒：造成的生命损耗降低100%，施加的属性增益和减益效果降低100%，每秒受到自身50%生命的真实伤害，因中毒受到的伤害会逐渐提升，最高提升100%。

When a battle starts, the Grave Alchemist releases poison gas across the battlefield. Only the area within 2 tiles of the Grave Alchemist is protected from the gas by a ward. Enemies become poisoned after remaining in the gas for 5s continuously. Poisoned enemies take true damage equal to 50% of their HP per second, inflict 100% less HP loss, and have the effects of the stat buffs and debuffs they apply reduced by 100%. This poison damage gradually increases, up to 100% more damage.
将毒药放进针筒向面前扫射，对面前4格扇形范围内的敌人造成40% ATK伤害。
The Grave Alchemist loads poison into a syringe and fires a sweeping barrage, dealing 40% ATK damage to enemies in a 4-tile frontal arc.
使用自己的所有手臂对目标连续攻击5次，每次造成20% ATK伤害。
The Grave Alchemist strikes the target 5 times with all arms, dealing 20% ATK damage with each strike.
诡计多端的演出家，会操控木偶为观众带来优美且残忍的舞剧。
A cunning showman who manipulates puppets to stage ballets as beautiful as they are cruel.
被动地，自身站在场外处于无敌不可选中的状态。主动释放，操作大量木偶袭击敌人，对全场敌人造成共计4次90% ATK的伤害，并对目标施加“爆偶印记”。短暂延迟后，印记发生爆炸，对目标及周围一格范围的敌人造成150% ATK的伤害。

Passive. The Soul Puppeteer stays off the battlefield, invincible and untargetable.
Active. The Soul Puppeteer sends a swarm of puppets to attack all enemies, dealing 90% ATK damage to them 4 times and applying a Blast Mark to each target. After a short delay, each mark explodes, dealing 150% ATK damage to the target and surrounding enemies within 1 tile.
提线鬼偶师会依据轮次准备处于不同位置的七个木偶。 战斗开始时，提线鬼偶师会将第一轮的木偶置入战场，木偶拥有提线鬼偶师初始攻击力5000%的血量，并且攻击力，护甲，魔抗实时同步为当前提线鬼偶师对应属性的90%。

The Soul Puppeteer prepares seven puppets for each wave, each in a different position. When a battle starts, the first wave enters the battlefield. Each puppet starts with HP equal to 5000% of the Soul Puppeteer's initial ATK. Its ATK, Phys DEF, and Magic DEF stay at 90% of the Soul Puppeteer's corresponding current stats.
被动的，木偶一直处于霸体状态，并且受到的伤害会同步至提线鬼偶师身上。当木偶被击败时，提线鬼偶师会收起这只木偶并立刻将下一个轮次的相同位置的木偶提前置入战场，并且被击败时溢出部分的伤害也会以生命流失的形式同步至新的木偶上。当同一波次木偶全部被击败时，提线鬼偶师会流失自身初始攻击力1000%的生命。

Passive. The puppets are always unaffected, and any damage they take is also dealt to the Soul Puppeteer. When a puppet is defeated, the Soul Puppeteer withdraws it and immediately brings in the corresponding puppet from the next wave to take its place. Any excess damage from the killing blow carries over to the new puppet as HP loss. When all puppets in a wave are defeated, the Soul Puppeteer loses HP equal to 1000% of its initial ATK.
拉扯丝线，强制所有木偶一同发出痛苦的尖啸，对全场敌人造成共计4次80% ATK的伤害，并削减其全部能量，同时使其受到伤害提升20%且无法回复能量，持续15秒。

The Soul Puppeteer pulls the strings and forces every puppet to shriek in pain together, dealing 80% ATK damage 4 times to all enemies and depleting all their Energy. It also increases their damage taken by 20% and prevents them from recovering Energy for 15s.
一名摧枯拉朽的远古守护者，外表受损后反而唤醒了其无坚不摧的隐藏力量。
Once a mighty presence on the battlefield, the golem now possesses an even greater power beneath its shattered form.
进行一段时间的蓄力，使能量汇聚于头顶，随后向场上所有敌人各自发射一道高能光束，造成600% ATK伤害并将目标击倒。若目标身上存在护盾，则光束会被完美反弹，并转而对巨型魔偶造成1000% ATK伤害。光束对巨型魔偶产生的伤害视为由成功反弹光束的角色所造成。

Charges briefly to gather energy and shoots energy beams to all enemies, dealing 600% ATK damage and knocking them down. If the targets are shielded, the energy beam will be fully reflected, dealing 1000% ATK damage to the Giant Golem. The reflected beam damage is attributed to the reflecting character.
右臂变形为能量巨剑，并进行两次大范围挥砍，每次挥砍对全场所有敌人造成250% ATK伤害。
Transforms the right arm into a massive blade and swings it twice, dealing 250% ATK damage to all enemies with each swing.
向距离自己最远的2名敌人各发射一枚能量球，命中后产生爆炸，对1格范围内的所有敌人造成200% ATK伤害和2秒眩晕。
Shoots an energy orb at 2 farthest enemies that explode upon hit, dealing 200% ATK damage to all adjacent enemies and stunning them for 2s.
